sentences.ja: 少し行くと、また戸があって、その前に、ガラスのつぼが一つ置いてありました。
sentences.romaji: Sukoshi iku to, mata to ga atte, sono mae ni, garasu no tsubo ga hitotsu oitearimashita.

translations.vi: Đi thêm một đoạn, lại có cửa, trước cửa đặt một chiếc hũ thủy tinh.
translations.en: A little further on was another door, with a glass jar in front of it.
translations.zh-Hans: 走了一会儿，又有一扇门，门前放着一个玻璃罐。
translations.zh-Hant: 走了一會兒，又有一扇門，門前放著一個玻璃罐。
translations.ko: 조금 가니 또 문이 있고, 그 앞에 유리 단지가 하나 놓여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa unahan ay may pinto ulit, at may garapong salamin sa harap.
translations.ne: अलि अघि फेरि ढोका थियो, अगाडि सिसाको भाँडो राखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Sedikit lagi, ada pintu dan sebuah stoples kaca di depannya.
translations.pt: Um pouco adiante, outra porta, com um pote de vidro diante dela.
translations.th: เดินไปอีกหน่อย มีประตูอีกบาน หน้าประตูวางโถแก้วไว้หนึ่งใบ
translations.si: ටිකක් ඉස්සරහට ගියාම ආයෙත් දොරක් තිබුණා, ඒක ඉස්සරහ වීදුරු භාජනයක් තියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: つぼ = hũ, bình. ガラス = thủy tinh.
grammarNote.en: つぼ = jar. ガラス = glass.
grammarNote.th: โถ แก้ว
grammarNote.si: つぼ = භාජනය, කළය. ガラス = වීදුරු.

sentences.ja: 戸には、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: To ni wa, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Trên cửa ghi thế này.
translations.en: The door said this.
translations.zh-Hans: 门上这样写着。
translations.zh-Hant: 門上這樣寫著。
translations.ko: 문에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Ganito ang nakasulat sa pinto.
translations.ne: ढोकामा यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di pintu tertulis begini.
translations.pt: Na porta estava escrito.
translations.th: ที่ประตูเขียนว่า
translations.si: දොරේ මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: こう書いてある = có ghi thế này.
grammarNote.en: こう書いてある = it's written like this.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: こう書いてある＝这样写着。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: こう書いてある＝這樣寫著。
grammarNote.th: เขียนไว้อย่างนี้
grammarNote.si: こう書いてある = මෙහෙම ලියලා තියෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 「つぼの中のクリームを、顔や手足に、すっかりぬってください。」

furigana.surface: に、すっかりぬってください。」

sentences.romaji: “Tsubo no naka no kuriimu o, kao ya teashi ni, sukkari nuttekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Xin hãy thoa kem trong hũ lên khắp mặt và tay chân."
translations.en: "Please rub the cream in the jar all over your face, hands, and feet."
translations.zh-Hans: “请把罐子里的奶油，全部抹在脸上和手脚上。”
translations.zh-Hant: “請把罐子裡的奶油，全部抹在臉上和手腳上。”
translations.ko: "단지 안의 크림을 얼굴과 손발에 빠짐없이 발라 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Ipahid po ang krema sa buong mukha at kamay at paa."
translations.ne: "भाँडोको क्रीम अनुहार र हातखुट्टामा राम्ररी दल्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Oleskan krim dalam stoples ke seluruh wajah dan tangan kaki."
translations.pt: "Passem o creme do pote no rosto, mãos e pés, por completo."
translations.my: "အိုးထဲက ခရင်မ်ကို မျက်နှာနဲ့ လက်ခြေ အနှံ့ လိမ်းပါ။"
translations.th: "โปรดทาครีมในโทให้ทั่วหน้าและมือเท้า"
translations.si: "භාජනයේ තියෙන ක්‍රීම් එක මූණෙයි අත් පයේයි හොඳට ගාගන්න."

grammarNote.vi: ぬる = thoa, bôi. すっかり = toàn bộ.
grammarNote.en: ぬる = apply, spread. すっかり = completely.
grammarNote.th: ทา ทั้งหมด
grammarNote.si: ぬる = ගානවා. すっかり = සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම.

sentences.ja: つぼの中を見ると、たしかに、牛乳のクリームでした。
sentences.romaji: Tsubo no naka o miru to, tashikani, gyuunyuu no kuriimu deshita.

translations.vi: Nhìn vào hũ, quả thật là kem sữa bò.
translations.en: Looking inside, it really was milk cream.
translations.zh-Hans: 往罐里一看，确实是牛奶做的奶油。
translations.zh-Hant: 往罐裡一看，確實是牛奶做的奶油。
translations.ko: 단지 안을 보니 정말 우유 크림이었습니다.
translations.tl: Pagtingin, krema nga ng gatas iyon.
translations.ne: भाँडोभित्र हेर्दा साँच्चै दूधको क्रीम थियो।
translations.id: Dilihat, memang krim susu.
translations.pt: Olhando, era mesmo creme de leite.
translations.my: အိုးထဲ ကြည့်တော့ တကယ်ပဲ နွားနို့ ခရင်မ်။
translations.th: มองในโท ก็เป็นครีมนมจริง ๆ
translations.si: භාජනය ඇතුළ බැලුවාම, ඇත්තටම කිරි ක්‍රීම්.

grammarNote.vi: たしかに = quả thật. 牛乳 = sữa bò.
grammarNote.en: たしかに = indeed. 牛乳 = milk.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: たしかに＝的确。牛乳＝牛奶。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: たしかに＝的確。牛乳＝牛奶。
grammarNote.th: จริง ๆ นม
grammarNote.si: たしかに = ඇත්තටම. 牛乳 = කිරි.

sentences.ja: 「クリームをぬれって、どういうわけだ。」

furigana.surface: 「クリームをぬれって、どういうわけだ。」

sentences.romaji: “Kuriimu o nure tte, douiu wake da.”

translations.vi: "Bảo thoa kem là ý gì đây?"
translations.en: "Why on earth would they tell us to put on cream?"
translations.zh-Hans: “叫我们抹奶油，这是什么道理？”
translations.zh-Hant: “叫我們抹奶油，這是什麼道理？”
translations.ko: "크림을 바르라니 무슨 영문이지?"
translations.tl: "Bakit kaya kami pinapahid ng krema?"
translations.ne: "क्रीम दल भन्नुको अर्थ के होला?"
translations.id: "Kenapa kita disuruh pakai krim?"
translations.pt: "Passar creme? Qual é o motivo?"
translations.my: "ခရင်မ် လိမ်းခိုင်းတာ ဘာအကြောင်းလဲ။"
translations.th: "ให้ทาครีมนี่ เพราะอะไรกัน"
translations.si: "ක්‍රීම් ගාන්න කියන්නේ මොකටද?"

grammarNote.vi: 〜って = (bảo rằng) ~. わけ = lý do.
grammarNote.en: 〜って = (saying) ~. わけ = reason.
grammarNote.th: ว่า ~ เหตุผล
grammarNote.si: 〜って = ~ කියලා. わけ = හේතුව.

sentences.ja: 「外がとても寒いだろう。部屋の中があたたかいと、ひびが切れる。そのためのクリームさ。」

furigana.surface: があたたかいと、ひびが
れる。そのためのクリームさ。」

sentences.romaji: “Soto ga totemo samuidarou. Heya no naka ga atatakai to, hibi ga kireru. Sono tame no kuriimu sa.”

translations.vi: "Ngoài trời rét lắm. Trong phòng ấm thì da sẽ nứt nẻ. Kem là để phòng chuyện đó."
translations.en: "It's freezing outside. If the room is warm, your skin will crack. The cream's for that."
translations.zh-Hans: “外面很冷。屋里暖和的话，皮肤会皲裂。这奶油就是为这个准备的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “外面很冷。屋裡暖和的話，皮膚會皸裂。這奶油就是為這個準備的。”
translations.ko: "밖이 아주 춥잖아. 방 안이 따뜻하면 살이 튼다고. 그걸 위한 크림이야."
translations.tl: "Napakalamig sa labas. Kung mainit sa loob, magbibitak ang balat. Para doon ang krema."
translations.ne: "बाहिर धेरै जाडो छ। कोठा तातो भए छाला फुट्छ। त्यसैका लागि क्रीम।"
translations.id: "Di luar dingin. Kalau ruangan hangat, kulit pecah-pecah. Krim ini untuk itu."
translations.pt: "Lá fora está gelado. Se o quarto é quente, a pele racha. O creme é para isso."
translations.my: "အပြင်က အရမ်း အေးတယ်။ အခန်းထဲ နွေးရင် အရေပြား အက်တယ်။ အဲဒါအတွက် ခရင်မ်ပေါ့။"
translations.th: "ข้างนอกหนาวมาก ถ้าในห้องอุ่น ผิวจะแตก ครีมนี้สำหรับป้องกันน่ะ"
translations.si: "එළිය හරිම සීතලයි නේ. කාමරේ ඇතුළ රස්නෙ නම් හම පැළෙනවා. ඒකට තමයි ක්‍රීම්."

grammarNote.vi: ひびが切れる = nứt nẻ da. 〜ための = dùng cho ~.
grammarNote.en: ひびが切れる = skin cracks. 〜ための = for ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ひびが切れる＝皮肤皲裂。〜ための＝为了……的。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ひびが切れる＝皮膚皸裂。〜ための＝為了……的。
grammarNote.my: အရေပြားအက်။ ~ အတွက်။
grammarNote.th: ผิวแตก สำหรับ ~
grammarNote.si: ひびが切れる = හම පැළෙනවා. 〜ための = ~ සඳහා.

sentences.ja: 「なるほど。この店には、よほどえらい人が来ているんだね。」
sentences.romaji: “Naruhodo. Kono mise ni wa, yohodo erai hito ga kiteiru n da ne.”

translations.vi: "Ra thế. Quán này chắc toàn nhân vật cực kỳ quan trọng đến."
translations.en: "I see. Very important people must come to this place."
translations.zh-Hans: “原来如此。这家店一定有相当了不起的人来。”
translations.zh-Hant: “原來如此。這家店一定有相當了不起的人來。”
translations.ko: "과연. 이 가게엔 꽤 높은 사람이 오나 봐."
translations.tl: "Ah. Siguro napakahalagang tao ang pumupunta rito."
translations.ne: "ठीक। यो पसलमा धेरै ठूला मान्छे आउँछन् होला।"
translations.id: "Pantas. Pasti orang yang sangat penting datang ke sini."
translations.pt: "Entendi. Deve vir gente muito importante aqui."
translations.th: "อย่างนี้นี่เอง ร้านนี้คงมีคนใหญ่คนโตมากมาย"
translations.si: "හරි. මේ කඩේට නම් හරිම ලොකු ලොකු අය එනවා ඇති."

grammarNote.vi: よほど = rất, hẳn là cực kỳ.
grammarNote.en: よほど = very, extremely.
grammarNote.th: มาก ๆ
grammarNote.si: よほど = හරිම, අතිශයින්.

sentences.ja: 二人は、つぼのクリームを、顔にぬって、手にぬって、それから、くつ下をぬいで足にもぬりました。

furigana.surface: にぬって、それから、くつ

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, tsubo no kuriimu o, kao ni nutte, te ni nutte, sorekara, kutsushita o nuide ashi ni mo nurimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người thoa kem lên mặt, lên tay, rồi cởi tất ra thoa cả chân.
translations.en: They put cream on their faces, their hands, then took off their socks and did their feet.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人把奶油抹在脸上、手上，又脱了袜子抹在脚上。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人把奶油抹在臉上、手上，又脫了襪子抹在腳上。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 크림을 얼굴에, 손에 바르고, 양말을 벗어 발에도 발랐습니다.
translations.tl: Pinahiran nila ang mukha, kamay, at hinubad ang medyas para sa paa.
translations.ne: दुवैले अनुहार, हात र मोजा खोलेर खुट्टामा पनि क्रीम दले।
translations.id: Mereka mengoles wajah, tangan, lalu melepas kaus kaki dan mengoles kaki.
translations.pt: Passaram no rosto, nas mãos, tiraram as meias e passaram nos pés.
translations.my: မျက်နှာ၊ လက် လိမ်းပြီး ခြေအိတ်ချွတ်ပြီး ခြေထောက်ပါ လိမ်းတယ်။
translations.th: สองคนทาหน้า ทามือ แล้วถอดถุงเท้าทาเท้าด้วย
translations.si: දෙන්නා භාජනයේ ක්‍රීම් මූණටත් ගාලා, අත්වලටත් ගාලා, ඊට පස්සේ මේස් ගලවලා කකුල්වලටත් ගෑවා.

grammarNote.vi: くつ下 = tất, vớ.
grammarNote.en: くつ下 = socks.
grammarNote.th: ถุงเท้า
grammarNote.si: くつ下 = මේස්.

sentences.ja: それでも、まだクリームが残っていたので、二人は、こっそり、それを顔にぬるふりをして食べました。

furigana.surface: それでも、まだクリームが

sentences.romaji: Soredemo, mada kuriimu ga nokotteita node, futari wa, kossori, sore o kao ni nuru furi o shite tabemashita.

translations.vi: Vẫn còn thừa kem, nên hai người lén giả vờ thoa lên mặt mà ăn luôn.
translations.en: There was still some left, so they secretly ate it, pretending to rub it on their faces.
translations.zh-Hans: 奶油还剩下一些，两人就偷偷装作往脸上抹，把它吃了。
translations.zh-Hant: 奶油還剩下一些，兩人就偷偷裝作往臉上抹，把它吃了。
translations.ko: 그래도 크림이 남아 있어서 두 사람은 몰래 얼굴에 바르는 척하며 먹었습니다.
translations.tl: May natira pa, kaya palihim nilang kinain habang kunwaring nagpapahid.
translations.ne: अझै क्रीम बाँकी थियो, त्यसैले दुवैले चुपचाप अनुहारमा दलेजस्तो गरेर खाए।
translations.id: Masih ada sisa, jadi diam-diam mereka memakannya sambil pura-pura mengoles.
translations.pt: Ainda sobrou, e eles, às escondidas, comeram fingindo passar no rosto.
translations.my: ခရင်မ် ကျန်သေးလို့ မျက်နှာ လိမ်းသလို ဟန်ဆောင်ပြီး တိတ်တိတ် စားလိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: ครีมยังเหลือ สองคนเลยแอบกินโดยทำทีเป็นทาหน้า
translations.si: ඒත් තාම ක්‍රීම් ඉතුරු වෙලා තිබුණු නිසා, දෙන්නා මූණේ ගානවා වගේ රඟපාලා හොරෙන් කෑවා.

grammarNote.vi: こっそり = lén lút. 〜ふりをする = giả vờ ~.
grammarNote.en: こっそり = secretly. 〜ふりをする = pretend to ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: こっそり＝偷偷。〜ふりをする＝假装……。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: こっそり＝偷偷。〜ふりをする＝假裝……。
grammarNote.my: တိတ်တိတ်။ ~ ဟန်ဆောင်။
grammarNote.th: แอบ แกล้งทำเป็น ~
grammarNote.si: こっそり = හොරෙන්. 〜ふりをする = ~ වගේ රඟපානවා.

sentences.ja: 急いで戸を開けると、そのうらには、こう書いてありました。

furigana.surface: けると、そのうらには、こう

sentences.romaji: Isoide to o akeru to, sono ura ni wa, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Vội mở cửa ra, mặt sau ghi thế này.
translations.en: They hurried to open the door; on the back it said this.
translations.zh-Hans: 急忙打开门，背面写着这样的话。
translations.zh-Hant: 急忙開啟門，背面寫著這樣的話。
translations.ko: 서둘러 문을 열자 그 뒤에는 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Nagmamadaling binuksan ang pinto; ganito ang nakasulat sa likod.
translations.ne: हतारमा ढोका खोल्दा पछाडि यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Buru-buru membuka pintu, di baliknya tertulis begini.
translations.pt: Abriram depressa a porta; atrás estava escrito.
translations.my: အမြန် တံခါး ဖွင့်တော့ နောက်မှာ ဒီလို ရေးထားတယ်။
translations.th: รีบเปิดประตู ด้านหลังเขียนว่า
translations.si: ඉක්මනට දොර ඇරියාම, ඒකේ පිටිපස්සේ මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 急いで = vội vàng.
grammarNote.en: 急いで = hurriedly.
grammarNote.th: รีบ
grammarNote.si: 急いで = ඉක්මනින්.

sentences.ja: 「クリームを、よくぬりましたか。耳にも、よくぬりましたか。」

furigana.surface: 「クリームを、よくぬりましたか。
にも、よくぬりましたか。」

sentences.romaji: “Kuriimu o, yoku nurimashita ka. Mimi ni mo, yoku nurimashita ka.”

translations.vi: "Quý khách đã thoa kem kỹ chưa? Cả tai cũng thoa kỹ chưa ạ?"
translations.en: "Have you applied the cream well? Your ears too?"
translations.zh-Hans: “奶油抹好了吗？耳朵也抹好了吗？”
translations.zh-Hant: “奶油抹好了嗎？耳朵也抹好了嗎？”
translations.ko: "크림을 잘 바르셨습니까? 귀에도 잘 바르셨습니까?"
translations.tl: "Naipahid ba nang mabuti? Pati sa tainga?"
translations.ne: "क्रीम राम्ररी दल्नुभयो? कानमा पनि?"
translations.id: "Sudah oles krim dengan baik? Telinga juga?"
translations.pt: "Passaram bem o creme? Nas orelhas também?"
translations.th: "ทาครีมดีแล้วหรือยัง หูด้วยหรือเปล่า"
translations.si: "ක්‍රීම් හොඳට ගෑවද? කන්වලටත් හොඳට ගෑවද?"

grammarNote.vi: 耳 = tai.
grammarNote.en: 耳 = ears.
grammarNote.th: หู
grammarNote.si: 耳 = කන්.

sentences.ja: 「そうそう、ぼくは耳にはぬらなかった。あぶないところだった。」

furigana.surface: にはぬらなかった。あぶないところだった。」

sentences.romaji: “Sou sou, boku wa mimi ni wa nuranakatta. Abunai tokoro datta.”

translations.vi: "Phải rồi, tôi chưa thoa tai. Suýt nữa thì nguy."
translations.en: "Oh right, I didn't do my ears. That was close."
translations.zh-Hans: “对了对了，我耳朵没抹。好险。”
translations.zh-Hant: “對了對了，我耳朵沒抹。好險。”
translations.ko: "맞다, 난 귀엔 안 발랐어. 큰일 날 뻔했다."
translations.tl: "Oo nga, hindi ko pinahiran ang tainga ko. Muntik na."
translations.ne: "हो हो, मैले कानमा दलेको छैन। ठिकै भयो।"
translations.id: "Oh iya, telingaku belum. Hampir saja."
translations.pt: "É mesmo, não passei nas orelhas. Foi por pouco."
translations.my: "ဟုတ်သားပဲ၊ ငါ နား မလိမ်းရသေးဘူး။ အန္တရာယ်ရှိတာ။"
translations.th: "จริงด้วย ฉันไม่ได้ทาหู เกือบไปแล้ว"
translations.si: "ඔව් ඔව්, මම කන්වලට ගෑවේ නැහැ. අල්ලපු ගාණෙන් බේරුණා."

grammarNote.vi: あぶないところ = suýt nữa thì nguy.
grammarNote.en: あぶないところ = a close call.
grammarNote.th: เกือบไป
grammarNote.si: あぶないところ = අල්ලපු ගාණෙන් බේරීම.

sentences.ja: 「ここの主人は、本当に、よく気がつく人だね。」
sentences.romaji: “Koko no shujin wa, hontouni, yoku ki ga tsuku hito da ne.”

translations.vi: "Chủ quán này đúng là người chu đáo thật."
translations.en: "The owner here really thinks of everything."
translations.zh-Hans: “这里的主人真是周到啊。”
translations.zh-Hant: “這裡的主人真是周到啊。”
translations.ko: "여기 주인은 정말 세심한 사람이네."
translations.tl: "Maalalahanin talaga ang may-ari rito."
translations.ne: "यहाँको साहु साँच्चै ध्यान दिने मान्छे रहेछ।"
translations.id: "Pemilik di sini benar-benar teliti."
translations.pt: "O dono daqui pensa em tudo mesmo."
translations.my: "ဒီဆိုင်ရှင်က တကယ် အသေးစိတ် ဂရုစိုက်တဲ့သူပဲ။"
translations.th: "เจ้าของที่นี่ช่างใส่ใจจริง ๆ"
translations.si: "මෙහේ අයිතිකාරයා ඇත්තටම හැම දේම ගැන හිතන කෙනෙක් නේ."

meanings.vi: chồng; chủ (ご主人: chồng người khác)
meanings.zh-Hans: 丈夫、主人（ご主人：别人的丈夫）
meanings.zh-Hant: 丈夫、主人（ご主人：別人的丈夫）
meanings.tl: asawa, amo (ご主人: asawa ng iba)
meanings.pt: marido, dono (ご主人: marido de alguém)
meanings.my: ခင်ပွန်း၊ သခင် (ご主人: သူတစ်ပါးခင်ပွန်း)
meanings.th: สามี นาย (ご主人: สามีของผู้อื่น)

grammarNote.vi: 主人 = chủ nhà. 気がつく = chu đáo.
grammarNote.en: 主人 = owner. 気がつく = attentive.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 主人＝主人。気がつく＝周到。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 主人＝主人。気がつく＝周到。
grammarNote.my: ပိုင်ရှင်။ ဂရုစိုက်။
grammarNote.th: เจ้าของ ใส่ใจ
grammarNote.si: 主人 = අයිතිකාරයා. 気がつく = සැලකිලිමත්.

sentences.ja: すると、すぐその前に、また次の戸がありました。
sentences.romaji: Suruto, sugu sono mae ni, mata tsugi no to ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Rồi ngay phía trước lại có một cánh cửa nữa.
translations.en: Then, right ahead, there was yet another door.
translations.zh-Hans: 这时，眼前又有下一扇门。
translations.zh-Hant: 這時，眼前又有下一扇門。
translations.ko: 그러자 바로 앞에 또 다음 문이 있었습니다.
translations.tl: At sa harap ay may isa na namang pinto.
translations.ne: अनि अगाडि नै फेरि अर्को ढोका थियो।
translations.id: Lalu tepat di depan, ada pintu lagi.
translations.pt: E logo à frente havia mais uma porta.
translations.my: ဒီတော့ ရှေ့မှာပဲ နောက်ထပ် တံခါး ရှိပြန်တယ်။
translations.th: แล้วตรงหน้าก็มีประตูถัดไปอีก
translations.si: එතකොට, ඉස්සරහාම ආයෙත් ඊළඟ දොරක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: すると = thế rồi.
grammarNote.en: すると = then.
grammarNote.th: แล้ว
grammarNote.si: すると = එතකොට.

sentences.ja: 「料理は、もうすぐできます。十五分もお待たせしません。」
sentences.romaji: “Ryouri wa, mousugu dekimasu. Juugofun mo omatase shimasen.”

translations.vi: "Món ăn sắp xong rồi. Quý khách không phải chờ đến mười lăm phút đâu."
translations.en: "The meal is almost ready. You won't wait even fifteen minutes."
translations.zh-Hans: “菜马上就好。不会让您等十五分钟的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “菜馬上就好。不會讓您等十五分鐘的。”
translations.ko: "요리는 곧 됩니다. 15분도 기다리시게 하지 않겠습니다."
translations.tl: "Malapit na ang pagkain. Hindi kayo maghihintay ng labinlimang minuto."
translations.ne: "खाना छिट्टै तयार हुन्छ। पन्ध्र मिनेट पनि पर्खाउँदैनौँ।"
translations.id: "Makanan hampir siap. Tak sampai lima belas menit."
translations.pt: "A comida está quase pronta. Não esperarão nem quinze minutos."
translations.my: "အစားအစာ မကြာခင် ရပါမယ်။ ဆယ့်ငါးမိနစ်တောင် မစောင့်ရပါဘူး။"
translations.th: "อาหารใกล้เสร็จแล้ว ไม่ต้องรอถึงสิบห้านาที"
translations.si: "කෑම දැන් ලෑස්ති වෙනවා. විනාඩි පහළොවක්වත් ඉන්න වෙන්නේ නැහැ."

grammarNote.vi: お待たせする = để (khách) phải chờ (khiêm nhường).
grammarNote.en: お待たせする = keep (you) waiting (humble).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: お待たせする＝让您久等（自谦）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: お待たせする＝讓您久等（自謙）。
grammarNote.th: ให้รอ
grammarNote.si: お待たせする = (ඔබව) බලාගෙන ඉන්න තියනවා (නිහතමානී).

sentences.ja: 「すぐ食べられます。早く、あなたの頭に、びんの中の香水を、よくふりかけてください。」

furigana.surface: を、よくふりかけてください。」

sentences.romaji: “Sugu taberaremasu. Hayaku, anata no atama ni, bin no naka no kousui o, yoku furikaketekudasai.”

translations.vi: "Sẽ được ăn ngay. Xin mau rảy nhiều nước hoa trong chai lên đầu."
translations.en: "You'll eat soon. Quickly, sprinkle the perfume in the bottle all over your head."
translations.zh-Hans: “马上就能吃。请快把瓶里的香水好好洒在头上。”
translations.zh-Hant: “馬上就能吃。請快把瓶裡的香水好好灑在頭上。”
translations.ko: "곧 드실 수 있습니다. 어서 병 안의 향수를 머리에 잘 뿌려 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Malapit na kayong kumain. Bilisan, iwisik ang pabango sa ulo."
translations.ne: "छिट्टै खान पाउनुहुन्छ। छिटो शिशीको अत्तर टाउकोमा राम्ररी छर्कनुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Segera bisa makan. Cepat semprotkan parfum dalam botol ke kepala."
translations.pt: "Logo vão comer. Depressa, borrifem o perfume do frasco na cabeça."
translations.my: "မကြာခင် စားရမယ်။ ပုလင်းထဲက ရေမွှေးကို ခေါင်းပေါ် မြန်မြန် ဖျန်းပါ။"
translations.th: "ใกล้ได้กินแล้ว รีบพรมน้ำหอมในขวดบนหัวให้ทั่ว"
translations.si: "ඉක්මනටම කන්න පුළුවන්. ඉක්මනට බෝතලයේ තියෙන සුවඳ විලවුන් ඔළුවට හොඳට ඉහගන්න."

grammarNote.vi: 香水 = nước hoa. ふりかける = rảy, rắc lên.
grammarNote.en: 香水 = perfume. ふりかける = sprinkle.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 香水＝香水。ふりかける＝洒上。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 香水＝香水。ふりかける＝灑上。
grammarNote.th: น้ำหอม พรม
grammarNote.si: 香水 = සුවඳ විලවුන්. ふりかける = ඉහිනවා.

sentences.ja: 戸の前には、金ぴかの香水のびんが置いてありました。
sentences.romaji: To no mae ni wa, kinpika no kousui no bin ga oitearimashita.

translations.vi: Trước cửa đặt một chai nước hoa vàng chóe.
translations.en: In front of the door stood a flashy gold perfume bottle.
translations.zh-Hans: 门前放着一个金光闪闪的香水瓶。
translations.zh-Hant: 門前放著一個金光閃閃的香水瓶。
translations.ko: 문 앞에는 금빛 번쩍이는 향수병이 놓여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa harap ng pinto ay may makintab na gintong bote ng pabango.
translations.ne: ढोकाअगाडि सुनौलो चम्किलो अत्तरको शिशी थियो।
translations.id: Di depan pintu ada botol parfum emas berkilau.
translations.pt: Diante da porta havia um frasco de perfume dourado e brilhante.
translations.th: หน้าประตูมีขวดน้ำหอมสีทองอร่าม
translations.si: දොර ඉස්සරහ රන් පාටින් දිලිසෙන සුවඳ විලවුන් බෝතලයක් තියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 金ぴか = vàng chóe. びん = chai.
grammarNote.en: 金ぴか = gaudy gold. びん = bottle.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 金ぴか＝金光闪闪。びん＝瓶。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 金ぴか＝金光閃閃。びん＝瓶。
grammarNote.th: ทองอร่าม ขวด
grammarNote.si: 金ぴか = රන් පාටින් දිලිසෙන. びん = බෝතලය.

sentences.ja: 二人は、その香水を、頭へぱちゃぱちゃふりかけました。

furigana.surface: へぱちゃぱちゃふりかけました。

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, sono kousui o, atama e pachapacha furikakemashita.

translations.vi: Hai người rảy nước hoa lách tách lên đầu.
translations.en: The two splashed the perfume on their heads.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人把香水哗哗地洒在头上。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人把香水嘩嘩地灑在頭上。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 그 향수를 머리에 찰박찰박 뿌렸습니다.
translations.tl: Iniwisik nila ang pabango sa ulo.
translations.ne: दुवैले अत्तर टाउकोमा छ्याप्छ्याप्ती छर्के।
translations.id: Keduanya memercikkan parfum ke kepala.
translations.pt: Os dois borrifaram o perfume na cabeça.
translations.th: สองคนพรมน้ำหอมบนหัวดังจ๋อม ๆ
translations.si: දෙන්නා ඒ සුවඳ විලවුන් ඔළුවට පචස් පචස් ගාලා ඉස්සා.

grammarNote.vi: ぱちゃぱちゃ = (tiếng) lách tách.
grammarNote.en: ぱちゃぱちゃ = splashing.
grammarNote.th: จ๋อม ๆ
grammarNote.si: ぱちゃぱちゃ = පචස් පචස් (වතුර ඉහිරෙන සද්දය).

sentences.ja: ところが、その香水は、どうも、すのような、すっぱいにおいがするのでした。

furigana.surface: は、どうも、すのような、すっぱいにおいがするのでした。

sentences.romaji: Tokoroga, sono kousui wa, doumo, su no you na, suppai nioi ga suru no deshita.

translations.vi: Thế nhưng, nước hoa ấy có mùi chua chua, giống như giấm.
translations.en: But somehow the perfume smelled sour, like vinegar.
translations.zh-Hans: 可是，那香水总有一股像醋一样的酸味。
translations.zh-Hant: 可是，那香水總有一股像醋一樣的酸味。
translations.ko: 그런데 그 향수는 어쩐지 식초 같은 시큼한 냄새가 났습니다.
translations.tl: Pero amoy-suka at maasim ang pabango.
translations.ne: तर त्यो अत्तर सिर्काजस्तो अमिलो गन्ध आउँथ्यो।
translations.id: Namun parfum itu berbau asam, seperti cuka.
translations.pt: Mas o perfume cheirava azedo, feito vinagre.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ အဲဒီရေမွှေးက ရှာလကာရည်လို ချဉ်တဲ့ အနံ့ ထွက်တယ်။
translations.th: แต่น้ำหอมนั้นมีกลิ่นเปรี้ยวเหมือนน้ำส้มสายชู
translations.si: ඒත් ඒ සුවඳ විලවුන් කොහොමදෝ විනාකිරි වගේ ඇඹුල් ගඳක් ගැහුවා.

grammarNote.vi: す = giấm. すっぱい = chua.
grammarNote.en: す = vinegar. すっぱい = sour.
grammarNote.my: ရှာလကာရည်။ ချဉ်။
grammarNote.th: น้ำส้มสายชู เปรี้ยว
grammarNote.si: す = විනාකිරි. すっぱい = ඇඹුල්.

sentences.ja: 「この香水は、へんに、すくさい。どうしたんだろう。」

furigana.surface: は、へんに、すくさい。どうしたんだろう。」

sentences.romaji: “Kono kousui wa, hen ni, sukusai. Dou shita n darou.”

translations.vi: "Nước hoa này hôi giấm kỳ lạ. Sao thế nhỉ?"
translations.en: "This perfume smells weirdly of vinegar. What's going on?"
translations.zh-Hans: “这香水怪怪的，一股醋味。怎么回事？”
translations.zh-Hant: “這香水怪怪的，一股醋味。怎麼回事？”
translations.ko: "이 향수 이상하게 식초 냄새가 나. 어떻게 된 거지?"
translations.tl: "Kakaibang amoy-suka ang pabangong ito. Ano kaya?"
translations.ne: "यो अत्तरमा अनौठो सिर्काको गन्ध छ। के भयो होला?"
translations.id: "Parfum ini anehnya bau cuka. Kenapa ya?"
translations.pt: "Este perfume cheira estranhamente a vinagre. O que houve?"
translations.my: "ဒီရေမွှေးက ထူးထူးဆန်းဆန်း ရှာလကာ နံတယ်။ ဘာဖြစ်တာလဲ။"
translations.th: "น้ำหอมนี่กลิ่นเปรี้ยวแปลก ๆ เกิดอะไรขึ้น"
translations.si: "මේ සුවඳ විලවුන් අමුතු විදිහට විනාකිරි ගඳයි. මොකද වුණේ?"

grammarNote.vi: すくさい = hôi mùi giấm. へんに = kỳ lạ.
grammarNote.en: すくさい = smells of vinegar. へんに = strangely.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: すくさい＝有醋味。へんに＝奇怪地。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: すくさい＝有醋味。へんに＝奇怪地。
grammarNote.my: ရှာလကာနံ။ ထူးဆန်း။
grammarNote.th: กลิ่นน้ำส้ม แปลก ๆ
grammarNote.si: すくさい = විනාකිරි ගඳයි. へんに = අමුතු විදිහට.

sentences.ja: 「まちがえたんだろう。店の女の人が、かぜでも引いて、まちがえて入れたのさ。」
sentences.romaji: “Machigaeta n darou. Mise no onna no hito ga, kaze demo hiite, machigaete ireta no sa.”

translations.vi: "Chắc nhầm thôi. Cô hầu bị cảm, nên đổ nhầm chứ gì."
translations.en: "A mistake, probably. The maid had a cold and filled it wrong."
translations.zh-Hans: “大概弄错了。店里的女佣感冒了，装错了吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “大概弄錯了。店裡的女傭感冒了，裝錯了吧。”
translations.ko: "실수했겠지. 가게 여자가 감기라도 걸려서 잘못 넣은 거야."
translations.tl: "Siguro nagkamali. Sinipon ang katulong at mali ang nailagay."
translations.ne: "गल्ती होला। पसलकी महिलालाई रुघा लागेर गलत राखिन्।"
translations.id: "Pasti salah. Pelayannya masuk angin, jadi salah isi."
translations.pt: "Foi engano. A moça devia estar resfriada e trocou."
translations.th: "คงผิดพลาดน่ะ สาวในร้านเป็นหวัด เลยใส่ผิด"
translations.si: "වැරදීමක් වෙන්න ඇති. කඩේ ගෑනු කෙනාට හෙම්බිරිස්සාව හැදිලා, වැරදිලා දාන්න ඇති."

grammarNote.vi: かぜを引く = bị cảm. まちがえる = nhầm.
grammarNote.en: かぜを引く = catch a cold. まちがえる = make a mistake.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: かぜを引く＝感冒。まちがえる＝弄错。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: かぜを引く＝感冒。まちがえる＝弄錯。
grammarNote.th: เป็นหวัด ผิดพลาด
grammarNote.si: かぜを引く = හෙම්බිරිස්සාව හැදෙනවා. まちがえる = වරදිනවා.

sentences.ja: 二人は、戸を開けて、中に入りました。
sentences.romaji: Futari wa, to o akete, naka ni hairimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người mở cửa, bước vào trong.
translations.en: The two opened the door and went in.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人打开门，走了进去。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人開啟門，走了進去。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 문을 열고 안으로 들어갔습니다.
translations.tl: Binuksan nila ang pinto at pumasok.
translations.ne: दुवैले ढोका खोलेर भित्र पसे।
translations.id: Keduanya membuka pintu dan masuk.
translations.pt: Os dois abriram a porta e entraram.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက်လုံး တံခါး ဖွင့်ပြီး အထဲ ဝင်တယ်။
translations.th: สองคนเปิดประตูเข้าไปข้างใน
translations.si: දෙන්නා දොර ඇරලා ඇතුළට ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: 開ける = mở.
grammarNote.en: 開ける = open.
grammarNote.th: เปิด
grammarNote.si: 開ける = අරිනවා.

sentences.ja: 戸のうらには、大きな字で、こう書いてありました。
sentences.romaji: To no ura ni wa, ookina ji de, kou kaitearimashita.

translations.vi: Mặt sau cửa ghi chữ thật to thế này.
translations.en: On the back of the door, in large letters, it said this.
translations.zh-Hans: 门背面用大字这样写着。
translations.zh-Hant: 門背面用大字這樣寫著。
translations.ko: 문 뒤에는 큰 글씨로 이렇게 쓰여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa likod ng pinto, malalaking letra ang nakasulat.
translations.ne: ढोकाको पछाडि ठूला अक्षरले यसो लेखिएको थियो।
translations.id: Di balik pintu tertulis huruf besar begini.
translations.pt: Atrás da porta, em letras grandes, dizia.
translations.th: ด้านหลังประตูเขียนตัวใหญ่ว่า
translations.si: දොරේ පිටිපස්සේ ලොකු අකුරෙන් මෙහෙම ලියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 大きな字 = chữ to.
grammarNote.en: 大きな字 = big letters.
grammarNote.th: ตัวใหญ่
grammarNote.si: 大きな字 = ලොකු අකුරු.

sentences.ja: 「いろいろ注文が多くて、うるさかったでしょう。お気の毒でした。」

furigana.surface: くて、うるさかったでしょう。お

sentences.romaji: “Iroiro chuumon ga ookute, urusakattadeshou. Okinodoku deshita.”

translations.vi: "Nhiều yêu cầu quá, chắc quý khách phiền lắm. Thật áy náy."
translations.en: "So many orders—how tiresome for you. We're very sorry."
translations.zh-Hans: “要求这么多，很烦人吧。真是对不起。”
translations.zh-Hant: “要求這麼多，很煩人吧。真是對不起。”
translations.ko: "이런저런 주문이 많아 귀찮으셨지요. 딱하게 되었습니다."
translations.tl: "Ang daming hiling, nakakainis siguro. Pasensya na po."
translations.ne: "धेरै अर्डरले झर्को लाग्यो होला। माफ गर्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Banyak pesanan, pasti merepotkan. Mohon maaf."
translations.pt: "Tantos pedidos, devem estar cansados. Sentimos muito."
translations.th: "คำสั่งเยอะ คงรำคาญ ขอโทษด้วย"
translations.si: "ඕඩර් ගොඩක් නිසා කරදරයක් වෙන්න ඇති. හරිම කනගාටුයි."

grammarNote.vi: うるさい = phiền phức. お気の毒 = thật đáng tiếc (cho anh).
grammarNote.en: うるさい = annoying. お気の毒 = how unfortunate (for you).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: うるさい＝烦人。お気の毒＝真遗憾（对您）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: うるさい＝煩人。お気の毒＝真遺憾（對您）。
grammarNote.my: စိတ်ညစ်။ သနားစရာ။
grammarNote.th: รำคาญ น่าสงสาร
grammarNote.si: うるさい = කරදරකාරී. お気の毒 = අනේ පව් (ඔබට).

sentences.ja: 「もう、これだけです。どうか、からだ中に、つぼの中の塩を、たくさん、よくもみこんでください。」

furigana.surface: 「もう、これだけです。どうか、からだ
を、たくさん、よくもみこんでください。」

sentences.romaji: “Mou, kore dake desu. Dou ka, karadajuu ni, tsubo no naka no shio o, takusan, yoku momikonde kudasai.”

translations.vi: "Chỉ còn thế này thôi. Xin hãy lấy muối trong hũ xoa thật nhiều, thật kỹ khắp người."
translations.en: "This is the last one. Please rub plenty of the salt in the jar all over your bodies."
translations.zh-Hans: “只剩这个了。请把罐里的盐，在全身好好地多揉一些。”
translations.zh-Hant: “只剩這個了。請把罐裡的鹽，在全身好好地多揉一些。”
translations.ko: "이제 이것뿐입니다. 부디 단지 속 소금을 온몸에 듬뿍 잘 문질러 주십시오."
translations.tl: "Ito na lang. Ipahid ang maraming asin sa buong katawan."
translations.ne: "अब यति मात्र। भाँडोको नुन जीउभरि धेरै राम्ररी मल्नुहोस्।"
translations.id: "Tinggal ini saja. Gosokkan banyak garam dalam stoples ke seluruh tubuh."
translations.pt: "É só isso. Esfreguem bastante sal do pote pelo corpo todo."
translations.th: "เหลือแค่นี้ โปรดเอาเกลือในโถถูให้ทั่วตัวเยอะ ๆ"
translations.si: "මේක තමයි අන්තිම එක. කරුණාකර භාජනයේ තියෙන ලුණු ගොඩක් ඇඟ පුරාම හොඳට අතුල්ලගන්න."

grammarNote.vi: 塩 = muối. もみこむ = xoa cho ngấm. からだ中 = khắp người.
grammarNote.en: 塩 = salt. もみこむ = rub in. からだ中 = all over the body.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 塩＝盐。もみこむ＝揉进去。からだ中＝全身。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 塩＝鹽。もみこむ＝揉進去。からだ中＝全身。
grammarNote.th: เกลือ ถู ทั้งตัว
grammarNote.si: 塩 = ලුණු. もみこむ = අතුල්ලලා උරා ගන්වනවා. からだ中 = ඇඟ පුරාම.

sentences.ja: なるほど、りっぱな青い瀬戸の塩つぼが置いてありました。
sentences.romaji: Naruhodo, rippa na aoi seto no shiotsubo ga oitearimashita.

translations.vi: Quả nhiên, có đặt một hũ muối bằng sứ xanh rất sang.
translations.en: Sure enough, a fine blue porcelain salt jar sat there.
translations.zh-Hans: 果然，放着一个精美的青瓷盐罐。
translations.zh-Hant: 果然，放著一個精美的青瓷鹽罐。
translations.ko: 과연 훌륭한 푸른 도자기 소금 단지가 놓여 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Totoo nga, may magarang asul na porselanang lalagyan ng asin.
translations.ne: साँच्चै, एउटा भव्य नीलो चिनीमाटोको नुनदानी थियो।
translations.id: Benar saja, ada wadah garam porselen biru yang mewah.
translations.pt: De fato, havia um belo pote azul de porcelana com sal.
translations.th: จริงด้วย มีโถเกลือกระเบื้องสีฟ้าอย่างดีวางอยู่
translations.si: ඇත්තටම, ලස්සන නිල් පෝසිලේන් ලුණු භාජනයක් තියලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 瀬戸 = đồ sứ.
grammarNote.en: 瀬戸 = porcelain.
grammarNote.th: กระเบื้อง
grammarNote.si: 瀬戸 = පෝසිලේන්.

sentences.ja: 今度という今度は、二人とも、ぎょっとして、おたがいの顔を見合わせました。

furigana.surface: とも、ぎょっとして、おたがいの

sentences.romaji: Kondo to iu kondo wa, futari tomo, gyotto shite, otagai no kao o miawasemashita.

translations.vi: Lần này thì đúng là lần này, cả hai giật bắn mình, nhìn mặt nhau.
translations.en: This time, at last, both of them froze and stared at each other.
translations.zh-Hans: 这一次，两人都吓了一跳，面面相觑。
translations.zh-Hant: 這一次，兩人都嚇了一跳，面面相覷。
translations.ko: 이번만큼은 두 사람 모두 섬뜩해서 서로 얼굴을 마주 보았습니다.
translations.tl: Sa wakas, pareho silang natigilan at nagkatinginan.
translations.ne: यसपटक त दुवै झस्किए र एक-अर्काको मुख हेरे।
translations.id: Kali ini, keduanya tersentak dan saling pandang.
translations.pt: Desta vez, os dois se assustaram e se entreolharam.
translations.my: ဒီတစ်ခါတော့ နှစ်ယောက်လုံး လန့်ပြီး မျက်နှာချင်း ကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: คราวนี้แหละ ทั้งคู่สะดุ้ง มองหน้ากัน
translations.si: මේ පාර නම් දෙන්නම ගැස්සිලා, එකිනෙකාගේ මූණු දිහා බලාගත්තා.

meanings.my: အချင်းချင်း ကြည့်
meanings.th: มองหน้ากัน

grammarNote.vi: 今度という今度は = lần này thì thật sự. ぎょっとする = giật mình.
grammarNote.en: 今度という今度は = this time for sure. ぎょっとする = be startled.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 今度という今度は＝这一次可真是。ぎょっとする＝吓一跳。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 今度という今度は＝這一次可真是。ぎょっとする＝嚇一跳。
grammarNote.my: ဒီတစ်ခါတော့။ လန့်။
grammarNote.th: คราวนี้แหละ สะดุ้ง
grammarNote.si: 今度という今度は = මේ පාර නම් ඇත්තටම. ぎょっとする = ගැස්සෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 「どうも、おかしいぜ。」
sentences.romaji: “Doumo, okashii ze.”

translations.vi: "Có gì đó kỳ quặc lắm."
translations.en: "Something's not right."
translations.zh-Hans: “有点不对劲啊。”
translations.zh-Hant: “有點不對勁啊。”
translations.ko: "아무래도 이상해."
translations.tl: "May mali rito."
translations.ne: "केही अनौठो छ।"
translations.id: "Ada yang aneh."
translations.pt: "Tem algo errado."
translations.my: "တစ်ခုခု ထူးဆန်းနေတယ်။"
translations.th: "มีอะไรแปลก ๆ"
translations.si: "කොහොමත් මොකක්හරි අවුලක් තියෙනවා."

grammarNote.vi: どうも = có vẻ, sao đó. 〜ぜ = (nam, thân mật).
grammarNote.en: どうも = somehow. 〜ぜ = (male, casual).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: どうも＝总觉得。〜ぜ＝（男性口语）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: どうも＝總覺得。〜ぜ＝（男性口語）。
grammarNote.th: ดูเหมือน (ผู้ชาย)
grammarNote.si: どうも = කොහොමත්. 〜ぜ = (පිරිමි, අවිධිමත්).

sentences.ja: 「ぼくも、おかしいと思う。」
sentences.romaji: “Boku mo, okashii to omou.”

translations.vi: "Tôi cũng thấy kỳ quặc."
translations.en: "I think so too."
translations.zh-Hans: “我也觉得不对劲。”
translations.zh-Hant: “我也覺得不對勁。”
translations.ko: "나도 이상하다고 생각해."
translations.tl: "Ganoon din ang tingin ko."
translations.ne: "मलाई पनि अनौठो लाग्छ।"
translations.id: "Aku juga merasa aneh."
translations.pt: "Também acho."
translations.my: "ငါလည်း ထူးဆန်းတယ် ထင်တယ်။"
translations.th: "ฉันก็คิดว่าแปลก"
translations.si: "මටත් අවුලක් කියලා හිතෙනවා."

grammarNote.vi: 〜と思う = nghĩ rằng ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜と思う = think that ~.
grammarNote.th: คิดว่า ~
grammarNote.si: 〜と思う = ~ කියලා හිතනවා.

sentences.ja: 「たくさんの注文というのは、向こうが、こっちへ注文しているんだよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Takusan no chuumon to iu no wa, mukou ga, kotchi e chuumonshiteiru n da yo.”

translations.vi: "Cái gọi là 'nhiều yêu cầu' là bên kia yêu cầu bên mình đấy."
translations.en: "The 'many orders' are orders they're giving to us!"
translations.zh-Hans: “所谓要求多，是对方在对我们提要求啊。”
translations.zh-Hant: “所謂要求多，是對方在對我們提要求啊。”
translations.ko: "주문이 많다는 건, 저쪽이 우리한테 주문하는 거야."
translations.tl: "Ang 'maraming hiling' ay sila ang humihiling sa atin!"
translations.ne: "धेरै अर्डर भनेको उनीहरूले हामीलाई अर्डर गरेको रहेछ।"
translations.id: "Yang dimaksud banyak pesanan adalah mereka memerintah kita!"
translations.pt: "Os 'muitos pedidos' são eles pedindo a nós!"
translations.my: "မှာစရာများတယ်ဆိုတာ ဟိုဘက်က ငါတို့ကို မှာနေတာပဲ။"
translations.th: "คำสั่งเยอะนี่คือฝั่งนั้นสั่งพวกเราต่างหาก"
translations.si: "ඕඩර් ගොඩක් කියන්නේ, එයාලා අපිට දෙන ඕඩර්!"

grammarNote.vi: 〜というのは = cái gọi là ~ thì. 向こう = phía bên kia.
grammarNote.en: 〜というのは = what's called ~ is. 向こう = the other side.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 〜というのは＝所谓……。向こう＝对方。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 〜というのは＝所謂……。向こう＝對方。
grammarNote.th: ที่เรียกว่า ~ ฝั่งนั้น
grammarNote.si: 〜というのは = ~ කියන්නේ. 向こう = අනිත් පැත්ත.

sentences.ja: 「つまり、西洋料理店というのは、来た人を、西洋料理にして、食べてやる店なんだ。」

furigana.reading: せいようりょうりてん

sentences.romaji: “Tsumari, seiyouryouriten to iu no wa, kita hito o, seiyou ryouri ni shite, tabeteyaru mise na n da.”

translations.vi: "Tức là, 'nhà hàng Tây' là quán biến khách đến thành món Tây rồi ăn thịt."
translations.en: "In other words, a 'Western restaurant' is a place that turns its guests into Western food and eats them."
translations.zh-Hans: “也就是说，所谓西餐馆，就是把来的人做成西餐吃掉的店。”
translations.zh-Hant: “也就是說，所謂西餐館，就是把來的人做成西餐吃掉的店。”
translations.ko: "즉, 서양요리점이란 온 사람을 서양 요리로 만들어 먹는 가게야."
translations.tl: "Ibig sabihin, ginagawang pagkain ang bisita at kinakain!"
translations.ne: "अर्थात्, पश्चिमी भोजनालय भनेको आउनेलाई पश्चिमी खाना बनाएर खाने पसल।"
translations.id: "Artinya, restoran Barat ini mengolah tamu jadi masakan lalu memakannya."
translations.pt: "Ou seja, 'restaurante ocidental' é um lugar que transforma os clientes em comida e os come."
translations.th: "คือว่า ร้านอาหารตะวันตกคือร้านที่เอาคนมาทำเป็นอาหารแล้วกิน"
translations.si: "ඒ කියන්නේ, 'බටහිර කෑම අවන්හල' කියන්නේ, එන අයව බටහිර කෑමක් කරලා කන තැනක්."

grammarNote.vi: つまり = tức là.
grammarNote.en: つまり = in other words.
grammarNote.my: ဆိုလိုတာက။
grammarNote.th: คือว่า
grammarNote.si: つまり = ඒ කියන්නේ.

sentences.ja: 「と、と、ということは、ぼ、ぼ、ぼくらが…。」

furigana.surface: 「と、と、ということは、ぼ、ぼ、ぼくらが…。」

sentences.romaji: “To, to, to iu koto wa, bo, bo, bokura ga....”

translations.vi: "Vậy, vậy, vậy là, chúng, chúng ta…"
translations.en: "Th-th-then that means w-w-we're…"
translations.zh-Hans: “那、那、那就是说，我、我、我们……”
translations.zh-Hant: “那、那、那就是說，我、我、我們……”
translations.ko: "그, 그, 그렇다는 건, 우, 우, 우리가…"
translations.tl: "K-k-kung gayon, t-t-tayo…"
translations.ne: "त-त-त्यसो भए ह-ह-हामी…"
translations.id: "J-j-jadi, k-k-kita…"
translations.pt: "E-e-então n-n-nós…"
translations.th: "ง-ง-งั้นก็แปลว่า พ-พ-พวกเรา…"
translations.si: "ඒ, ඒ, ඒ කියන්නේ, අ, අ, අපි…"

grammarNote.vi: Nói lắp vì sợ.
grammarNote.en: Stammering from fear.
grammarNote.th: พูดติดอ่างเพราะกลัว
grammarNote.si: බයෙන් ගොත ගැසීම.

sentences.ja: 二人は、がたがたふるえだして、もう、ものが言えませんでした。

furigana.surface: は、がたがたふるえだして、もう、ものが

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, gatagata furuedashite, mou, mono ga iemasendeshita.

translations.vi: Hai người bắt đầu run cầm cập, không nói nên lời.
translations.en: The two began to shake and could no longer speak.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人开始哆哆嗦嗦地发抖，说不出话来。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人開始哆哆嗦嗦地發抖，說不出話來。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 덜덜 떨기 시작해 말도 못 했습니다.
translations.tl: Nagsimula silang manginig at hindi makapagsalita.
translations.ne: दुवै थरथर काँप्न थाले, बोल्नै सकेनन्।
translations.id: Keduanya gemetar dan tak bisa bicara.
translations.pt: Os dois tremiam e não conseguiam falar.
translations.th: สองคนเริ่มตัวสั่น พูดไม่ออก
translations.si: දෙන්නා ගැහි ගැහී වෙව්ලන්න පටන් අරන්, තවත් වචනයක්වත් කතා කරන්න බැරි වුණා.

grammarNote.vi: ふるえだす = bắt đầu run. がたがた = cầm cập.
grammarNote.en: ふるえだす = start to tremble. がたがた = shaking.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ふるえだす＝开始发抖。がたがた＝哆嗦。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ふるえだす＝開始發抖。がたがた＝哆嗦。
grammarNote.my: တုန်စ။ တဆတ်ဆတ်။
grammarNote.th: เริ่มสั่น สั่นเทา
grammarNote.si: ふるえだす = වෙව්ලන්න පටන් ගන්නවා. がたがた = ගැහි ගැහී.

sentences.romaji: “Nige....”

translations.vi: "Chạy…"
translations.en: "Run…"
translations.ko: "도망…"
translations.tl: "Takbo…"
translations.id: "Lari…"
translations.pt: "Fuja…"

grammarNote.vi: にげる = chạy trốn.
grammarNote.en: にげる = run away.
grammarNote.th: หนี
grammarNote.si: にげる = පැනලා දුවනවා.

sentences.ja: 後ろの戸をおそうとしましたが、戸は、もう、一ミリも動きませんでした。

furigana.surface: をおそうとしましたが、

sentences.romaji: Ushiro no to o osou to shimashita ga, to wa, mou, ichimiri mo ugokimasendeshita.

translations.vi: Họ định đẩy cánh cửa phía sau, nhưng cửa không nhúc nhích một li.
translations.en: They tried to push the door behind them, but it wouldn't budge a millimeter.
translations.zh-Hans: 他们想推后面的门，可门一毫米也推不动。
translations.zh-Hant: 他們想推後面的門，可門一毫米也推不動。
translations.ko: 뒤의 문을 밀려고 했지만 문은 이미 1밀리도 움직이지 않았습니다.
translations.tl: Itinulak nila ang pinto sa likod pero hindi gumalaw kahit kaunti.
translations.ne: पछाडिको ढोका धकेल्न खोजे, तर ढोका एक मिलिमिटर पनि सरेन।
translations.id: Mereka mencoba mendorong pintu belakang, tapi tak bergeser sedikit pun.
translations.pt: Tentaram empurrar a porta de trás, mas não se mexeu nem um milímetro.
translations.my: နောက်တံခါးကို တွန်းမလို့ လုပ်ပေမဲ့ တစ်မီလီမီတာမှ မလှုပ်ဘူး။
translations.th: พยายามผลักประตูข้างหลัง แต่ไม่ขยับแม้แต่มิลลิเมตรเดียว
translations.si: පිටිපස්සේ දොර තල්ලු කරන්න හැදුවත්, දොර මිලිමීටරයක්වත් හෙලවුණේ නැහැ.

grammarNote.vi: おす = đẩy. 〜も〜ない = không ~ chút nào.
grammarNote.en: おす = push. 〜も〜ない = not even ~.
grammarNote.th: ผลัก ไม่ ~ เลย
grammarNote.si: おす = තල්ලු කරනවා. 〜も〜ない = ~ වත් නැහැ.

sentences.ja: おくのほうには、まだ一まい戸があって、大きなかぎあなが二つついていました。
sentences.romaji: Oku no hou ni wa, mada ichimai to ga atte, ookina kagiana ga futatsu tsuiteimashita.

translations.vi: Phía trong còn một cánh cửa nữa, có hai lỗ khóa to.
translations.en: Further in was one more door with two big keyholes.
translations.zh-Hans: 里面还有一扇门，上面有两个大钥匙孔。
translations.zh-Hant: 裡面還有一扇門，上面有兩個大鑰匙孔。
translations.ko: 안쪽에는 아직 문이 한 장 더 있고, 큰 열쇠 구멍이 두 개 나 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa loob ay may isa pang pinto na may dalawang malaking butas ng susi.
translations.ne: भित्रपट्टि अर्को ढोका थियो, त्यसमा दुईवटा ठूला साँचोका प्वाल थिए।
translations.id: Di dalam ada satu pintu lagi dengan dua lubang kunci besar.
translations.pt: Lá dentro havia mais uma porta com dois buracos de fechadura grandes.
translations.my: အတွင်းဘက်မှာ တံခါး တစ်ချပ် ထပ်ရှိပြီး သော့ပေါက်ကြီး နှစ်ခု ပါတယ်။
translations.th: ข้างในยังมีประตูอีกบาน มีรูกุญแจใหญ่สองรู
translations.si: ඇතුළු පැත්තේ තව එක දොරක් තිබුණා, ඒකේ ලොකු යතුරු සිදුරු දෙකක් තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: かぎあな = lỗ khóa.
grammarNote.en: かぎあな = keyhole.
grammarNote.th: รูกุญแจ
grammarNote.si: かぎあな = යතුරු සිදුර.

sentences.ja: かぎあなからは、青い目玉が二つ、きょろきょろ、こっちをのぞいています。

furigana.surface: つ、きょろきょろ、こっちをのぞいています。

sentences.romaji: Kagiana kara wa, aoi medama ga futatsu, kyorokyoro, kotchi o nozoiteimasu.

translations.vi: Qua lỗ khóa, hai con mắt xanh lấm lét nhìn sang phía này.
translations.en: Through the keyholes, two blue eyeballs darted about, peering at them.
translations.zh-Hans: 从钥匙孔里，两只蓝眼珠滴溜溜地往这边看。
translations.zh-Hant: 從鑰匙孔裡，兩隻藍眼珠滴溜溜地往這邊看。
translations.ko: 열쇠 구멍에서 파란 눈알 두 개가 두리번두리번 이쪽을 엿보고 있습니다.
translations.tl: Mula sa butas, dalawang asul na mata ang sumisilip sa kanila.
translations.ne: साँचोको प्वालबाट दुईवटा नीला आँखा यताउता गर्दै चियाइरहेका थिए।
translations.id: Dari lubang kunci, dua bola mata biru melirik ke arah sini.
translations.pt: Pelos buracos, dois olhos azuis espiavam de um lado a outro.
translations.th: จากรูกุญแจ ลูกตาสีฟ้าสองดวงกลอกไปมามองมาทางนี้
translations.si: යතුරු සිදුරුවලින් නිල් ඇස් ගුලි දෙකක් එහාට මෙහාට කරකවමින් මෙහාට එබිලා බලනවා.

grammarNote.vi: 目玉 = con ngươi. きょろきょろ = đảo mắt. のぞく = nhìn trộm.
grammarNote.en: 目玉 = eyeballs. きょろきょろ = darting. のぞく = peep.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 目玉＝眼珠。きょろきょろ＝滴溜溜转。のぞく＝窥视。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 目玉＝眼珠。きょろきょろ＝滴溜溜轉。のぞく＝窺視。
grammarNote.pt: olhos. de lá pra cá. espiar.
grammarNote.th: ลูกตา กลอกไปมา แอบมอง
grammarNote.si: 目玉 = ඇස් ගුලි. きょろきょろ = එහාට මෙහාට. のぞく = එබිලා බලනවා.

sentences.ja: 「だめだよ。もう気がついたよ。塩をもみこまないようだよ。」

furigana.surface: をもみこまないようだよ。」

sentences.romaji: “Dame da yo. Mou kigatsuita yo. Shio o momikomanai you da yo.”

translations.vi: "Hỏng rồi. Chúng nó nhận ra rồi. Có vẻ không chịu xoa muối đâu."
translations.en: "No good. They've noticed. Looks like they won't rub in the salt."
translations.zh-Hans: “不行了。他们发觉了。好像不肯揉盐了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “不行了。他們發覺了。好像不肯揉鹽了。”
translations.ko: "글렀어. 벌써 눈치챘어. 소금을 안 바를 모양이야."
translations.tl: "Hindi na. Napansin na nila. Mukhang hindi sila magpapahid ng asin."
translations.ne: "भएन। थाहा पाइसके। नुन मल्दैनन् जस्तो छ।"
translations.id: "Gagal. Mereka sudah sadar. Sepertinya tak mau pakai garam."
translations.pt: "Não deu. Perceberam. Parece que não vão passar o sal."
translations.th: "ไม่ได้แล้ว พวกนั้นรู้ตัวแล้ว ดูเหมือนจะไม่ถูเกลือ"
translations.si: "වැඩක් නැහැ. දැන් තේරිලා. ලුණු අතුල්ලන්නේ නැති පාටයි."

grammarNote.vi: 〜ようだ = có vẻ ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜ようだ = seems ~.
grammarNote.th: ดูเหมือน ~
grammarNote.si: 〜ようだ = ~ වගේ පේනවා.

sentences.ja: 「あたりまえさ。親分の書き方がまずいんだ。」
sentences.romaji: “Atarimaesa. Oyabun no kakikata ga mazui n da.”

translations.vi: "Đương nhiên rồi. Tại đại ca viết dở quá."
translations.en: "Of course. The boss wrote it badly."
translations.zh-Hans: “那当然。头儿写得太差了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “那當然。頭兒寫得太差了。”
translations.ko: "당연하지. 두목이 글을 서투르게 썼거든."
translations.tl: "Siyempre. Pangit sumulat ang amo."
translations.ne: "स्वाभाविक हो। मालिकले नराम्रो लेखे।"
translations.id: "Tentu saja. Bos menulisnya jelek."
translations.pt: "Claro. O chefe escreveu mal."
translations.th: "แน่นอนอยู่แล้ว ลูกพี่เขียนไม่เก่ง"
translations.si: "ඉතින් ඔව් නේ. ලොක්කා ලියපු විදිහ වැරදියි."

grammarNote.vi: あたりまえ = đương nhiên. 親分 = đại ca, ông chủ. まずい = vụng, dở.
grammarNote.en: あたりまえ = obvious. 親分 = boss. まずい = poor, clumsy.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: あたりまえ＝当然。親分＝头儿。まずい＝拙劣。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: あたりまえ＝當然。親分＝頭兒。まずい＝拙劣。
grammarNote.th: แน่นอน ลูกพี่ ไม่เก่ง
grammarNote.si: あたりまえ = පැහැදිලි දෙයක්. 親分 = ලොක්කා. まずい = නරක, අදක්ෂ.

sentences.ja: 「どっちでもいいよ。早く、来ないかなあ。」
sentences.romaji: “Dotchi demo ii yo. Hayaku, konai ka naa.”

translations.vi: "Sao cũng được. Mau vào đây đi chứ."
translations.en: "Whatever. I wish they'd hurry up and come in."
translations.zh-Hans: “随便啦。快点进来吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “隨便啦。快點進來吧。”
translations.ko: "아무래도 좋아. 빨리 안 오나."
translations.tl: "Kahit ano. Sana bilisan nilang pumasok."
translations.ne: "जे होस्। छिटो आए हुन्थ्यो।"
translations.id: "Terserah. Cepatlah masuk."
translations.pt: "Tanto faz. Tomara que entrem logo."
translations.my: "ဘာဖြစ်ဖြစ်။ မြန်မြန် လာပါစေ။"
translations.th: "ช่างเถอะ รีบเข้ามาได้แล้ว"
translations.si: "මොකක් වුණත් කමක් නැහැ. ඉක්මනට ඇතුළට ආවොත් හොඳයි."

grammarNote.vi: 〜ないかなあ = mong sao ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜ないかなあ = I wish ~ would.
grammarNote.th: อยากให้ ~ จัง
grammarNote.si: 〜ないかなあ = ~ කළොත් හොඳයි (ප්‍රාර්ථනාව).

sentences.ja: 「お客さん、早くいらっしゃい。お皿もあらってあります。菜っ葉も、もう塩でもんであります。」
sentences.romaji: “Okyakusan, hayaku irasshai. Osara mo arattearimasu. Nappa mo, mou shio de monde arimasu.”

translations.vi: "Thưa quý khách, mau vào đi ạ. Đĩa đã rửa sẵn. Rau cũng đã bóp muối rồi."
translations.en: "Dear guests, do come in. The plates are washed. The greens are already salted."
translations.zh-Hans: “客人，快进来吧。盘子已经洗好了。菜叶也已经用盐揉好了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “客人，快進來吧。盤子已經洗好了。菜葉也已經用鹽揉好了。”
translations.ko: "손님, 어서 오세요. 접시도 씻어 두었어요. 채소도 벌써 소금에 절여 두었어요."
translations.tl: "Mga panauhin, pasok na po. Hugas na ang plato. May asin na ang gulay."
translations.ne: "पाहुना, छिटो आउनुहोस्। थाल धोइसकेका छौँ। सागमा पनि नुन मलिसक्यौँ।"
translations.id: "Tamu, cepat masuk. Piring sudah dicuci. Sayur sudah digarami."
translations.pt: "Prezados, entrem logo. Os pratos estão lavados. As verduras já têm sal."
translations.my: "ဧည့်သည်တော်၊ မြန်မြန် ကြွပါ။ ပန်းကန် ဆေးထားပြီ။ ဟင်းရွက်လည်း ဆားနယ်ထားပြီ။"
translations.th: "ท่านลูกค้า รีบเข้ามาเถอะ ล้างจานไว้แล้ว ผักก็ขยำเกลือไว้แล้ว"
translations.si: "ගරු අමුත්තනි, ඉක්මනට එන්න. පිඟානුත් හෝදලා. කොළ වර්ගත් දැනටමත් ලුණු දාලා අතුල්ලලා."

grammarNote.vi: 菜っ葉 = rau lá. もむ = bóp, nhào.
grammarNote.en: 菜っ葉 = leafy greens. もむ = knead, rub.
grammarNote.my: ဟင်းရွက်။ နယ်။
grammarNote.th: ผักใบ ขยำ
grammarNote.si: 菜っ葉 = කොළ වර්ග. もむ = අතුල්ලනවා, පොඩි කරනවා.

sentences.ja: 「あとは、あなたがたと、菜っ葉をうまくとりあわせて、白いお皿にのせるだけです。」

furigana.surface: をうまくとりあわせて、

sentences.romaji: “Ato wa, anatagata to, nappa o umaku toriawasete, shiroi osara ni noseru dake desu.”

translations.vi: "Chỉ còn phải trộn các vị với rau cho khéo, rồi bày lên đĩa trắng thôi ạ."
translations.en: "All that's left is to arrange you nicely with the greens on white plates."
translations.zh-Hans: “剩下的，只要把各位和菜叶好好地配在一起，放到白盘子上就行了。”
translations.zh-Hant: “剩下的，只要把各位和菜葉好好地配在一起，放到白盤子上就行了。”
translations.ko: "이제 남은 건 여러분과 채소를 잘 곁들여 하얀 접시에 담는 것뿐이에요."
translations.tl: "Ang natitira, ihanay kayo kasama ang gulay sa puting plato."
translations.ne: "अब बाँकी भनेको तपाईंहरूलाई सागसँग मिलाएर सेतो थालमा राख्ने मात्र।"
translations.id: "Tinggal menata kalian dengan sayur di piring putih."
translations.pt: "Só falta arrumar vocês com as verduras em pratos brancos."
translations.my: "ကျန်တာက ခင်ဗျားတို့နဲ့ ဟင်းရွက်ကို လှလှ ပေါင်းပြီး ပန်းကန်ဖြူပေါ် တင်ရုံပဲ။"
translations.th: "ที่เหลือก็แค่จัดพวกท่านกับผักให้สวย แล้ววางบนจานขาว"
translations.si: "ඉතුරු වෙලා තියෙන්නේ ඔයාලවයි කොළ වර්ගයි ලස්සනට එකට සකස් කරලා සුදු පිඟානට දාන එක විතරයි."

grammarNote.vi: とりあわせる = phối hợp. のせる = đặt lên.
grammarNote.en: とりあわせる = combine, arrange. のせる = place on.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: とりあわせる＝搭配。のせる＝放上。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: とりあわせる＝搭配。のせる＝放上。
grammarNote.th: จัด วาง
grammarNote.si: とりあわせる = එකට සකසනවා. のせる = උඩින් තියනවා.

sentences.ja: 二人は、あまりのこわさに、顔が、まるで、くしゃくしゃの紙くずのようになりました。

furigana.surface: が、まるで、くしゃくしゃの
くずのようになりました。

sentences.romaji: Futari wa, amarino kowasa ni, kao ga, marude, kushakusha no kamikuzu no you ni narimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người sợ quá, mặt nhăn nhúm lại y như tờ giấy vụn bị vò.
translations.en: So terrified were the two that their faces crumpled up just like wadded wastepaper.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人吓得脸皱成一团，简直像揉皱的废纸。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人嚇得臉皺成一團，簡直像揉皺的廢紙。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 너무 무서워서 얼굴이 마치 구깃구깃한 휴지처럼 되었습니다.
translations.tl: Sa sobrang takot, nalukot ang mukha nila na parang papel.
translations.ne: अति डरले दुवैको अनुहार चाउरी परेको कागजजस्तो भयो।
translations.id: Karena sangat takut, wajah mereka jadi kusut seperti kertas bekas.
translations.pt: De tanto medo, os rostos ficaram amassados como papel velho.
translations.my: အရမ်း ကြောက်လို့ မျက်နှာတွေ တွန့်ကြေနေတဲ့ စက္ကူစလို ဖြစ်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: ด้วยความกลัวสุดขีด หน้าของสองคนยับยู่ยี่เหมือนกระดาษขยำ
translations.si: දෙන්නාගේ මූණු ඕනෑවට වඩා බය නිසා, හරියට පොඩි කරපු කඩදාසි කෑල්ලක් වගේ හැකිළුණා.

grammarNote.vi: くしゃくしゃ = nhàu nát. 紙くず = giấy vụn. あまりの〜に = vì quá ~.
grammarNote.en: くしゃくしゃ = crumpled. 紙くず = wastepaper. あまりの〜に = from too much ~.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: くしゃくしゃ＝皱巴巴。紙くず＝废纸。あまりの〜に＝因为太……。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: くしゃくしゃ＝皺巴巴。紙くず＝廢紙。あまりの〜に＝因為太……。
grammarNote.my: တွန့်ကြေ။ စက္ကူစ။ အရမ်း ~ လို့။
grammarNote.th: ยับยู่ยี่ เศษกระดาษ เพราะ ~ เกินไป
grammarNote.si: くしゃくしゃ = හැකිළුණු. 紙くず = කඩදාසි කුණු. あまりの〜に = ඕනෑවට වඩා ~ නිසා.

sentences.ja: そして、おたがいに顔を見合わせ、ぶるぶるふるえて、声もなく泣きました。

furigana.surface: わせ、ぶるぶるふるえて、

sentences.romaji: Soshite, otagai ni kao o miawase, buruburu furuete, koe mo naku nakimashita.

translations.vi: Họ nhìn nhau, run lẩy bẩy, khóc không thành tiếng.
translations.en: They looked at each other, trembling, and wept without a sound.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人面面相觑，浑身发抖，无声地哭了。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人面面相覷，渾身發抖，無聲地哭了。
translations.ko: 서로 얼굴을 마주 보고 부들부들 떨며 소리 없이 울었습니다.
translations.tl: Nagkatinginan sila, nanginginig, at umiyak nang walang tunog.
translations.ne: एक-अर्कालाई हेर्दै थरथर काँप्दै आवाज ननिकाली रोए।
translations.id: Mereka saling pandang, gemetar, dan menangis tanpa suara.
translations.pt: Entreolharam-se, tremendo, e choraram sem som.
translations.my: အချင်းချင်း ကြည့်ပြီး တုန်တုန်နဲ့ အသံမထွက်ဘဲ ငိုတယ်။
translations.th: มองหน้ากัน ตัวสั่น ร้องไห้ไร้เสียง
translations.si: ඊට පස්සේ එකිනෙකාගේ මූණු බලාගෙන, වෙව්ල වෙව්ලා, සද්දයක් නැතිව ඇඬුවා.

grammarNote.vi: 声もなく = không thành tiếng. ぶるぶる = lẩy bẩy.
grammarNote.en: 声もなく = without a sound. ぶるぶる = trembling.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 声もなく＝无声地。ぶるぶる＝发抖。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 聲もなく＝無聲地。ぶるぶる＝發抖。
grammarNote.my: အသံမထွက်ဘဲ။ တုန်တုန်။
grammarNote.th: ไร้เสียง สั่นเทา
grammarNote.si: 声もなく = සද්දයක් නැතිව. ぶるぶる = වෙව්ල වෙව්ලා.

sentences.ja: そのときです。後ろから、とつぜん、「ワン、ワン、ガアッ」という声がしました。

furigana.surface: ろから、とつぜん、「ワン、ワン、ガアッ」という

sentences.romaji: Sono toki desu. Ushiro kara, totsuzen, “Wan, wan, gaa” to iu koe ga shimashita.

translations.vi: Đúng lúc đó, từ phía sau bỗng vang lên tiếng "Gâu, gâu, grừ!"
translations.en: Just then, from behind came a sudden "Woof, woof, grrr!"
translations.zh-Hans: 就在这时，身后突然传来“汪、汪、嗷”的声音。
translations.zh-Hant: 就在這時，身後突然傳來“汪、汪、嗷”的聲音。
translations.ko: 그때였습니다. 뒤에서 갑자기 "멍, 멍, 으르렁" 하는 소리가 났습니다.
translations.tl: Noon din, may biglang "Aw, aw, grrr!" mula sa likod.
translations.ne: त्यही बेला पछाडिबाट अचानक "भुक, भुक, ग्रर!" आवाज आयो।
translations.id: Saat itu, tiba-tiba terdengar "Guk, guk, grrr!" dari belakang.
translations.pt: Nisso, de trás veio de repente: "Au, au, grrr!"
translations.my: အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ နောက်ကနေ ရုတ်တရက် "ဝုတ်၊ ဝုတ်၊ ဂရ" ဆိုတဲ့ အသံ ထွက်လာတယ်။
translations.th: ตอนนั้นเอง ข้างหลังมีเสียง "โฮ่ง โฮ่ง แฮ่!" ดังขึ้นทันที
translations.si: හරියටම ඒ වෙලාවේ, පිටිපස්සෙන් එකපාරටම "බව් බව්, ගර්ර්!" කියලා සද්දයක් ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: とつぜん = đột nhiên.
grammarNote.en: とつぜん = suddenly.
grammarNote.th: ทันใด
grammarNote.si: とつぜん = එකපාරටම.

sentences.ja: あの白い犬が二ひき、戸をつきやぶって、部屋の中へとびこんできたのです。

furigana.surface: へとびこんできたのです。

sentences.romaji: Ano shiroi inu ga nihiki, to o tsukiyabutte, heya no naka e tobikondekita no desu.

translations.vi: Hai con chó trắng kia phá cửa, lao vào trong phòng.
translations.en: Those two white dogs had burst through the door and leapt into the room.
translations.zh-Hans: 那两条白狗撞破门，冲进了屋里。
translations.zh-Hant: 那兩條白狗撞破門，衝進了屋裡。
translations.ko: 그 하얀 개 두 마리가 문을 부수고 방 안으로 뛰어든 것입니다.
translations.tl: Ang dalawang puting aso ay sumugod sa pinto papasok.
translations.ne: ती दुई सेता कुकुरले ढोका फोडेर कोठाभित्र हाम फाले।
translations.id: Dua anjing putih itu mendobrak pintu dan melompat masuk.
translations.pt: Os dois cães brancos arrombaram a porta e pularam para dentro.
translations.my: အဲဒီ ခွေးဖြူ နှစ်ကောင် တံခါး ချိုးဖောက်ပြီး အခန်းထဲ ခုန်ဝင်လာတာ။
translations.th: สุนัขขาวสองตัวนั้นพังประตูกระโจนเข้ามาในห้อง
translations.si: අර සුදු බල්ලෝ දෙන්නා දොර කඩාගෙන කාමරේ ඇතුළට පැනලා ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: つきやぶる = phá thủng. とびこむ = lao vào.
grammarNote.en: つきやぶる = break through. とびこむ = leap in.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: つきやぶる＝撞破。とびこむ＝冲进。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: つきやぶる＝撞破。とびこむ＝衝進。
grammarNote.th: พัง กระโจนเข้า
grammarNote.si: つきやぶる = කඩාගෙන යනවා. とびこむ = ඇතුළට පනිනවා.

sentences.ja: かぎあなの目玉は、たちまち、消えてしまいました。
sentences.romaji: Kagiana no medama wa, tachimachi, kieteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Đôi mắt ở lỗ khóa lập tức biến mất.
translations.en: The eyes in the keyholes vanished at once.
translations.zh-Hans: 钥匙孔里的眼珠，一下子就消失了。
translations.zh-Hant: 鑰匙孔裡的眼珠，一下子就消失了。
translations.ko: 열쇠 구멍의 눈알은 순식간에 사라져 버렸습니다.
translations.tl: Agad nawala ang mga mata sa butas ng susi.
translations.ne: साँचोको प्वालका आँखा तुरुन्तै हराए।
translations.id: Mata di lubang kunci seketika lenyap.
translations.pt: Os olhos nos buracos sumiram na hora.
translations.th: ลูกตาในรูกุญแจหายวับไปทันที
translations.si: යතුරු සිදුරුවල ඇස් ගුලි එවෙලේම නැතිවෙලා ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: たちまち = ngay lập tức.
grammarNote.en: たちまち = instantly.
grammarNote.my: ချက်ချင်း။
grammarNote.th: ทันที
grammarNote.si: たちまち = එවෙලේම.

sentences.ja: 犬は、うなりながら、部屋の中をぐるぐる回り、次の戸に、とびつきました。
sentences.romaji: Inu wa, unarinagara, heya no naka o guruguru mawari, tsugi no to ni, tobitsukimashita.

translations.vi: Hai con chó gầm gừ, chạy vòng vòng trong phòng rồi nhảy xổ vào cánh cửa tiếp theo.
translations.en: Growling, the dogs circled the room, then sprang at the next door.
translations.zh-Hans: 狗低吼着，在屋里转来转去，扑向了下一扇门。
translations.zh-Hant: 狗低吼著，在屋裡轉來轉去，撲向了下一扇門。
translations.ko: 개는 으르렁거리며 방 안을 빙빙 돌다가 다음 문에 달려들었습니다.
translations.tl: Umuungol, umikot ang aso sa kuwarto at sinugod ang susunod na pinto.
translations.ne: कुकुर गुर्राउँदै कोठामा घुमे र अर्को ढोकामा झम्टिए।
translations.id: Menggeram, anjing berputar di ruangan lalu menerjang pintu berikutnya.
translations.pt: Rosnando, os cães rodearam a sala e saltaram na porta seguinte.
translations.my: ခွေးတွေ ဟိန်းပြီး အခန်းထဲ ပတ်ပြေးပြီး နောက်တံခါးကို ခုန်အုပ်တယ်။
translations.th: สุนัขคำราม วิ่งวนในห้อง แล้วกระโจนใส่ประตูถัดไป
translations.si: බල්ලෝ ගොරව ගොරවා කාමරේ වටේ කැරකිලා, ඊළඟ දොරට පැන්නා.

grammarNote.vi: ぐるぐる = vòng vòng. とびつく = nhảy xổ vào.
grammarNote.en: ぐるぐる = round and round. とびつく = pounce.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ぐるぐる＝团团转。とびつく＝扑上去。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ぐるぐる＝團團轉。とびつく＝撲上去。
grammarNote.my: ပတ်ပတ်။ ခုန်အုပ်။
grammarNote.th: วนไปวนมา กระโจนใส่
grammarNote.si: ぐるぐる = වටේට වටේට. とびつく = පනිනවා.

sentences.ja: 戸は、がたりと開いて、犬は、すいこまれるように、中へとびこんでいきました。

furigana.surface: は、すいこまれるように、
へとびこんでいきました。

sentences.romaji: To wa, gatari to hiraite, inu wa, suikomareru you ni, naka e tobikondeikimashita.

translations.vi: Cánh cửa bật mở đánh cạch, chó lao vào bên trong như bị hút vào.
translations.en: The door swung open with a clatter, and the dogs plunged in as if sucked inside.
translations.zh-Hans: 门“咣当”一声开了，狗像被吸进去一样冲了进去。
translations.zh-Hant: 門“咣噹”一聲開了，狗像被吸進去一樣衝了進去。
translations.ko: 문이 덜컹 열리자 개는 빨려 들어가듯 안으로 뛰어들어 갔습니다.
translations.tl: Bumukas ang pinto at pumasok ang aso na parang hinigop.
translations.ne: ढोका खट्ट खुल्यो र कुकुर तानिएजस्तै भित्र पसे।
translations.id: Pintu terbuka berderak, dan anjing melesat masuk seperti tersedot.
translations.pt: A porta abriu com um estalo e os cães entraram como sugados.
translations.my: တံခါး ဂျောက်ခနဲ ပွင့်ပြီး ခွေးတွေ စုပ်ယူခံရသလို အထဲ ခုန်ဝင်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: ประตูเปิดดังโครม สุนัขพุ่งเข้าไปราวกับถูกดูด
translations.si: දොර කටස් ගාලා ඇරුණා, බල්ලෝ ඇතුළට ඇදිලා යනවා වගේ පැනලා ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: がたりと = (tiếng) cạch. すいこむ = hút vào.
grammarNote.en: がたりと = with a clatter. すいこむ = suck in.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: がたりと＝咣当。すいこむ＝吸进。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: がたりと＝咣噹。すいこむ＝吸進。
grammarNote.th: โครม ดูด
grammarNote.si: がたりと = කටස් ගාලා. すいこむ = ඇදගන්නවා.

sentences.ja: その戸の向こうの、真っ暗な中で、「にゃあお、くわあ、ごろごろ」という声がしました。

furigana.surface: で、「にゃあお、くわあ、ごろごろ」という

sentences.romaji: Sono to no mukou no, makkura na naka de, “Nyaao, kuwaa, gorogoro” to iu koe ga shimashita.

translations.vi: Trong bóng tối sau cánh cửa ấy vang lên tiếng "Meo, quác, grừ grừ".
translations.en: In the pitch dark beyond that door came cries: "Meow-oo, kwaa, purr-rumble."
translations.zh-Hans: 门那边漆黑一片，传来“喵呜、哇、咕噜咕噜”的声音。
translations.zh-Hant: 門那邊漆黑一片，傳來“喵嗚、哇、咕嚕咕嚕”的聲音。
translations.ko: 그 문 너머 캄캄한 곳에서 "야옹, 꽥, 그르릉" 하는 소리가 났습니다.
translations.tl: Sa dilim sa kabila ng pinto, may "Ngiyaw, kwaa, grrr."
translations.ne: त्यो ढोकापारि अँध्यारोमा "म्याउँ, क्वा, घुरघुर" आवाज आयो।
translations.id: Di kegelapan balik pintu, terdengar "Meong, kwaa, grr-grr."
translations.pt: No escuro do outro lado, ouviu-se: "Miau, quá, grr-grr."
translations.th: ในความมืดหลังประตูนั้น มีเสียง "เหมียว กวาก ครืดคราด"
translations.si: ඒ දොරෙන් එහා ඝන අඳුරේ, "මියාවූ, ක්වා, ගුරු ගුරු" කියලා සද්ද ආවා.

meanings.my: မှောင်မည်း

grammarNote.vi: 真っ暗 = tối om. Tiếng mèo và chó vật lộn.
grammarNote.en: 真っ暗 = pitch dark. Sounds of cats and dogs fighting.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 真っ暗＝漆黑。猫和狗打斗的声音。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 真っ暗＝漆黑。貓和狗打鬥的聲音。
grammarNote.tl: madilim. away ng pusa at aso.
grammarNote.ne: अँध्यारो। बिरालो र कुकुर लडेको आवाज।
grammarNote.id: gelap. suara kucing dan anjing bertarung.
grammarNote.pt: breu. briga de gatos e cães.
grammarNote.th: มืดสนิท เสียงแมวกับหมาสู้กัน
grammarNote.si: 真っ暗 = ඝන අඳුර. බළලුන්ගෙයි බල්ලන්ගෙයි සටනේ සද්ද.

sentences.ja: それから、がさがさと音がしました。
sentences.romaji: Sorekara, gasagasa to oto ga shimashita.

translations.vi: Rồi có tiếng sột soạt.
translations.en: Then came a rustling sound.
translations.zh-Hans: 接着是一阵沙沙的声音。
translations.zh-Hant: 接著是一陣沙沙的聲音。
translations.ko: 그러고 나서 바스락바스락 소리가 났습니다.
translations.tl: Pagkatapos ay may kaluskos.
translations.ne: त्यसपछि खसखस आवाज आयो।
translations.id: Lalu terdengar bunyi gemeresik.
translations.pt: Depois, um farfalhar.
translations.my: ပြီးတော့ တရှဲရှဲ အသံ ထွက်တယ်။
translations.th: จากนั้นมีเสียงกรอบแกรบ
translations.si: ඊට පස්සේ සර සර ගාලා සද්දයක් ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: がさがさ = sột soạt.
grammarNote.en: がさがさ = rustling.
grammarNote.th: กรอบแกรบ
grammarNote.si: がさがさ = සර සර.

sentences.ja: 部屋は、けむりのように消えて、二人は、寒さにぶるぶるふるえながら、草の中に立っていました。

furigana.surface: さにぶるぶるふるえながら、

sentences.romaji: Heya wa, kemuri no you ni kiete, futari wa, samusa ni buruburu furuenagara, kusa no naka ni tatteimashita.

translations.vi: Căn phòng tan biến như làn khói, hai người đứng giữa đám cỏ, run cầm cập vì lạnh.
translations.en: The room vanished like smoke, and the two stood in the grass, shivering with cold.
translations.zh-Hans: 房间像烟一样消失了，两人站在草丛中，冻得直发抖。
translations.zh-Hant: 房間像煙一樣消失了，兩人站在草叢中，凍得直髮抖。
translations.ko: 방은 연기처럼 사라지고, 두 사람은 추위에 부들부들 떨며 풀숲에 서 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Naglaho ang kuwarto na parang usok; nakatayo sila sa damuhan, nanginginig sa lamig.
translations.ne: कोठा धुवाँजस्तै हरायो, दुवै जाडोले काँप्दै घाँसमा उभिएका थिए।
translations.id: Ruangan lenyap seperti asap; keduanya berdiri di rerumputan, menggigil kedinginan.
translations.pt: A sala sumiu como fumaça; os dois estavam no mato, tremendo de frio.
translations.my: အခန်းက မီးခိုးလို ပျောက်သွားပြီး နှစ်ယောက်လုံး အအေးဒဏ်နဲ့ တုန်ပြီး မြက်ထဲ ရပ်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ห้องหายไปเหมือนควัน สองคนยืนตัวสั่นเพราะหนาวอยู่กลางพงหญ้า
translations.si: කාමරය දුමක් වගේ නැතිවෙලා ගිහින්, දෙන්නා සීතලට වෙව්ල වෙව්ලා තණකොළ මැද හිටගෙන හිටියා.

grammarNote.vi: けむり = khói. 寒さ = cái lạnh.
grammarNote.en: けむり = smoke. 寒さ = the cold.
grammarNote.th: ควัน ความหนาว
grammarNote.si: けむり = දුම. 寒さ = සීතල.

sentences.ja: 見ると、上着もくつもさいふも、あちこちの木のえだに、ぶらさがったり、根もとにちらばったりしています。

furigana.surface: もくつもさいふも、あちこちの
のえだに、ぶらさがったり、
もとにちらばったりしています。

sentences.romaji: Miru to, uwagi mo kutsu mo saifu mo, achikochi no ki no eda ni, burasagattari, nemoto ni chirabattari shiteimasu.

translations.vi: Nhìn quanh, áo khoác, giày, ví treo lủng lẳng trên cành cây khắp nơi, hoặc vương vãi dưới gốc.
translations.en: Their coats, shoes, and wallets dangled from branches all around, or lay scattered at the roots.
translations.zh-Hans: 一看，上衣、鞋子、钱包挂在到处的树枝上，或散落在树根旁。
translations.zh-Hant: 一看，上衣、鞋子、錢包掛在到處的樹枝上，或散落在樹根旁。
translations.ko: 보니 윗옷도 신발도 지갑도 여기저기 나뭇가지에 매달려 있거나 뿌리께에 흩어져 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Nakasabit sa mga sanga o nakakalat sa ugat ang amerikana, sapatos, at pitaka.
translations.ne: हेर्दा कोट, जुत्ता र पर्स यताउता रुखका हाँगामा झुन्डिएका वा फेदमा छरिएका थिए।
translations.id: Mantel, sepatu, dan dompet tergantung di dahan atau berserakan di akar.
translations.pt: Casacos, sapatos e carteiras pendiam dos galhos ou jaziam espalhados nas raízes.
translations.my: ကြည့်တော့ အင်္ကျီ၊ ဖိနပ်၊ ပိုက်ဆံအိတ်တွေ ဟိုဒီ သစ်ကိုင်းမှာ ချိတ်နေတာ၊ ပင်ခြေမှာ ပြန့်ကျဲနေတာ။
translations.th: มองดู เสื้อนอก รองเท้า กระเป๋าสตางค์ ห้อยอยู่ตามกิ่งไม้ หรือกระจัดกระจายที่โคนต้น
translations.si: බැලුවාම, කබාත් සපත්තුත් පසුම්බිත් වටේ තියෙන ගස් අතුවල එල්ලිලා, නැත්නම් ගස් මුල්වල විසිරිලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 上着 = áo khoác. ちらばる = vương vãi. 根もと = gốc cây.
grammarNote.en: 上着 = jacket. ちらばる = be scattered. 根もと = base of a tree.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 上着＝上衣。ちらばる＝散落。根もと＝根部。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 上著＝上衣。ちらばる＝散落。根もと＝根部。
grammarNote.th: เสื้อนอก กระจัดกระจาย โคนต้น
grammarNote.si: 上着 = කබාය. ちらばる = විසිරෙනවා. 根もと = ගස් මුල.

sentences.ja: また、風がどうとふいて、草はざわざわ、木の葉はかさかさ鳴りました。
sentences.romaji: Mata, kaze ga dou to fuite, kusa wa zawazawa, konoha wa kasakasa narimashita.

translations.vi: Gió lại thổi ào ào, cỏ xào xạc, lá cây lao xao.
translations.en: Again the wind blew hard; the grass rustled, the leaves rattled.
translations.zh-Hans: 风又呼呼地吹，草沙沙作响，树叶哗哗地响。
translations.zh-Hant: 風又呼呼地吹，草沙沙作響，樹葉嘩嘩地響。
translations.ko: 또 바람이 휭 불고, 풀은 사각사각, 나뭇잎은 바스락바스락 울렸습니다.
translations.tl: Muling humihip ang hangin; kumaluskos ang damo at dahon.
translations.ne: फेरि हावा सुसाउँदै चल्यो, घाँस सरसर, पात खसखस गरे।
translations.id: Angin kembali bertiup kencang, rumput berdesir, daun bergemerisik.
translations.pt: De novo o vento soprou; o capim farfalhou, as folhas chiaram.
translations.my: လေ ထပ် ဝုန်းခနဲ တိုက်ပြီး မြက် တရှဲရှဲ၊ သစ်ရွက် တဖျပ်ဖျပ် မြည်တယ်။
translations.th: ลมพัดวู่อีก หญ้าไหวซู่ซ่า ใบไม้ดังกรอบแกรบ
translations.si: ආයෙත් සුළඟ හූ ගාලා හැමුවා, තණකොළ සර සර ගාලා, ගස් කොළ කර කර ගාලා සද්ද කළා.

grammarNote.vi: Câu lặp lại từ phần 1, đánh dấu trở về thực tại.
grammarNote.en: The refrain from Part 1 returns, marking the return to reality.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 第1部分的反复句，表示回到现实。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 第1部分的反覆句，表示回到現實。
grammarNote.tl: Ulit mula Bahagi 1: balik sa realidad.
grammarNote.ne: भाग १ को दोहोरिने वाक्य, यथार्थमा फर्किएको।
grammarNote.pt: Refrão da parte 1: volta à realidade.
grammarNote.my: အပိုင်း ၁ က ထပ်ကျော့စာ၊ လက်တွေ့ ပြန်ရောက်။
grammarNote.th: ประโยคซ้ำจากตอนที่ 1 กลับสู่ความจริง
grammarNote.si: 1 කොටසේ පුනරාවර්තන පේළිය ආයෙත් එනවා, යථාර්ථයට ආපසු ආ බව පෙන්වන්න.

sentences.ja: 犬が、ふうとうなって、もどってきました。

furigana.surface: が、ふうとうなって、もどってきました。

sentences.romaji: Inu ga, fuuto unatte, modottekimashita.

translations.vi: Hai con chó gầm khẽ một tiếng rồi quay về.
translations.en: The dogs came back with a low growl.
translations.zh-Hans: 狗“呼”地低吼一声，回来了。
translations.zh-Hant: 狗“呼”地低吼一聲，回來了。
translations.ko: 개가 흥 하고 으르렁거리며 돌아왔습니다.
translations.tl: Bumalik ang mga aso na umuungol nang mahina.
translations.ne: कुकुर हल्का गुर्राउँदै फर्किए।
translations.id: Anjing kembali sambil menggeram pelan.
translations.pt: Os cães voltaram com um rosnado baixo.
translations.my: ခွေးတွေ ဟုန်းခနဲ အသံပေးပြီး ပြန်လာတယ်။
translations.th: สุนัขคำรามเบา ๆ แล้วกลับมา
translations.si: බල්ලෝ "හ්ම්" ගාලා ගොරවලා ආපහු ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: もどる = quay về.
grammarNote.en: もどる = return.
grammarNote.th: กลับมา
grammarNote.si: もどる = ආපහු එනවා.

sentences.ja: 後ろからは、「だんなあ、だんなあ」と、さけぶ声がしました。

furigana.surface: ろからは、「だんなあ、だんなあ」と、さけぶ

sentences.romaji: Ushiro kara wa, “Dannaa, dannaa” to, sakebu koe ga shimashita.

translations.vi: Từ phía sau, có tiếng gọi: "Các cậu ơi, các cậu ơi."
translations.en: From behind came a shout: "Sirs! Sirs!"
translations.zh-Hans: 后面传来“老爷——老爷——”的喊声。
translations.zh-Hant: 後面傳來“老爺——老爺——”的喊聲。
translations.ko: 뒤에서 "나리, 나리" 하고 외치는 소리가 났습니다.
translations.tl: Mula sa likod, may sumisigaw ng "Ginoo! Ginoo!"
translations.ne: पछाडिबाट "हजुर, हजुर" भनेर कराएको आवाज आयो।
translations.id: Dari belakang terdengar teriakan, "Tuan! Tuan!"
translations.pt: De trás veio um grito: "Patrões! Patrões!"
translations.my: နောက်ကနေ "သခင်၊ သခင်" လို့ အော်သံ ကြားတယ်။
translations.th: ข้างหลังมีเสียงตะโกน "นายท่าน นายท่าน"
translations.si: පිටිපස්සෙන් "මහත්තයලා, මහත්තයලා" කියලා කෑගහන සද්දයක් ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: だんな = ông chủ, các cậu (gọi người giàu).
grammarNote.en: だんな = sir, master.
grammarNote.th: นายท่าน
grammarNote.si: だんな = මහත්තයා, ස්වාමියා.

sentences.ja: 「だんなあ、だんなあ、ここですか。」

furigana.surface: 「だんなあ、だんなあ、ここですか。」

sentences.romaji: “Dannaa, dannaa, koko desu ka.”

translations.vi: "Các cậu ơi, các cậu có ở đây không?"
translations.en: "Sirs, sirs, are you here?"
translations.zh-Hans: “老爷，老爷，您在这里吗？”
translations.zh-Hant: “老爺，老爺，您在這裡嗎？”
translations.ko: "나리, 나리, 여기 계십니까?"
translations.tl: "Ginoo, ginoo, nandito ba kayo?"
translations.ne: "हजुर, हजुर, यहाँ हुनुहुन्छ?"
translations.id: "Tuan, tuan, di sini?"
translations.pt: "Patrões, patrões, estão aqui?"
translations.my: "သခင်၊ သခင်၊ ဒီမှာလား။"
translations.th: "นายท่าน นายท่าน อยู่ที่นี่หรือเปล่า"
translations.si: "මහත්තයලා, මහත්තයලා, මෙතනද ඉන්නේ?"

grammarNote.vi: 〜ですか = có phải ~ không.
grammarNote.en: 〜ですか = is it ~?
grammarNote.th: ~ ไหม
grammarNote.si: 〜ですか = ~ ද?

sentences.ja: それは、道案内の人でした。
sentences.romaji: Sore wa, michiannai no hito deshita.

translations.vi: Đó là người dẫn đường.
translations.en: It was their guide.
translations.zh-Hans: 那是向导。
translations.zh-Hant: 那是嚮導。
translations.ko: 그것은 길 안내인이었습니다.
translations.tl: Ang gabay pala iyon.
translations.ne: त्यो बाटो देखाउने मान्छे थियो।
translations.id: Itu pemandu jalan.
translations.pt: Era o guia.
translations.my: အဲဒါ လမ်းပြ ဖြစ်တယ်။
translations.th: นั่นคือคนนำทาง
translations.si: ඒ මඟ පෙන්නපු කෙනා.

grammarNote.vi: それは〜でした = đó là ~.
grammarNote.en: それは〜でした = that was ~.
grammarNote.th: นั่นคือ ~
grammarNote.si: それは〜でした = ඒ ~.

sentences.ja: 二人は、やっと安心して、その人が持ってきたおだんごを食べ、東京へ帰りました。
sentences.romaji: Futari wa, yatto anshinshite, sono hito ga mottekita odango o tabe, toukyou e kaerimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người mới yên tâm, ăn bánh dango người đó mang theo, rồi về Tokyo.
translations.en: Relieved at last, they ate the dumplings he'd brought and went home to Tokyo.
translations.zh-Hans: 两人终于放心了，吃了他带来的团子，回到了东京。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩人終於放心了，吃了他帶來的糰子，回到了東京。
translations.ko: 두 사람은 겨우 안심하고 그가 가져온 경단을 먹고 도쿄로 돌아갔습니다.
translations.tl: Nakahinga sila nang maluwag, kumain ng dango, at umuwi sa Tokyo.
translations.ne: दुवैले बल्ल ढुक्क भएर उसले ल्याएको दाङ्गो खाए र टोकियो फर्के।
translations.id: Akhirnya lega, mereka makan dango yang dibawanya, lalu pulang ke Tokyo.
translations.pt: Enfim aliviados, comeram os bolinhos que ele trouxe e voltaram a Tóquio.
translations.th: สองคนโล่งใจในที่สุด กินดังโงะที่เขาเอามา แล้วกลับโตเกียว
translations.si: දෙන්නා අන්තිමේදී සැනසිල්ලෙන්, එයා ගෙනාපු ඩැන්ගෝ කාලා, ටෝකියෝවලට ආපහු ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: 安心する = yên tâm. おだんご = bánh dango (viên bột gạo).
grammarNote.en: 安心する = feel relieved. おだんご = rice dumplings.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 安心する＝放心。おだんご＝团子。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 安心する＝放心。おだんご＝糰子。
grammarNote.th: โล่งใจ ดังโงะ
grammarNote.si: 安心する = සැනසෙනවා. おだんご = ඩැන්ගෝ (හාල් පිටි ගුලි).

sentences.ja: しかし、さっき一ぺん紙くずのようになった二人の顔は、東京に帰っても、お湯に入っても、もう、もとのとおりになおりませんでした。

furigana.surface: っても、もう、もとのとおりになおりませんでした。

sentences.romaji: Shikashi, sakki ippen kamikuzu no you ni natta futari no kao wa, toukyou ni kaette mo, oyu ni haitte mo, mou, moto no toori ni naorimasendeshita.

translations.vi: Nhưng khuôn mặt một lần đã nhàu như giấy vụn của hai người, về đến Tokyo, có tắm nước nóng, cũng không bao giờ trở lại như cũ.
translations.en: But their faces, once crumpled like wastepaper, never went back to normal—not in Tokyo, not even in a hot bath.
translations.zh-Hans: 然而，那两张一度皱得像废纸的脸，回到东京，泡了热水澡，也再没有恢复原样。
translations.zh-Hant: 然而，那兩張一度皺得像廢紙的臉，回到東京，泡了熱水澡，也再沒有恢復原樣。
translations.ko: 하지만 한 번 휴지처럼 구겨진 두 사람의 얼굴은 도쿄에 돌아가도, 목욕을 해도 다시는 원래대로 돌아오지 않았습니다.
translations.tl: Pero ang mukhang minsang nalukot ay hindi na bumalik sa dati, kahit sa Tokyo, kahit maligo sa mainit na tubig.
translations.ne: तर एक पटक कागजजस्तो चाउरी परेको अनुहार टोकियो फर्केर, तातो पानीमा नुहाउँदा पनि पहिलेजस्तो भएन।
translations.id: Namun wajah yang sekali kusut seperti kertas itu tak pernah kembali seperti semula, meski di Tokyo atau berendam air panas.
translations.pt: Mas os rostos, uma vez amassados, nunca voltaram ao normal, nem em Tóquio, nem no banho quente.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ တစ်ခါ စက္ကူစလို တွန့်သွားတဲ့ မျက်နှာတွေက တိုကျို ပြန်ရောက်လည်း၊ ရေနွေးချိုးလည်း မူလအတိုင်း ပြန်မဖြစ်တော့ဘူး။
translations.th: แต่หน้าที่เคยยับเหมือนเศษกระดาษ แม้กลับโตเกียว แม้แช่น้ำร้อน ก็ไม่กลับเป็นเหมือนเดิมอีกเลย
translations.si: ඒත් වරක් පොඩි කරපු කඩදාසි කෑල්ලක් වගේ වුණු දෙන්නාගේ මූණු, ටෝකියෝවලට ගියත්, උණු වතුරෙන් නෑවත්, ආයෙත් කවදාවත් කලින් විදිහට හැදුණේ නැහැ.

grammarNote.vi: Câu kết nổi tiếng nguyên tác. 〜ても = dù ~. もとのとおり = như cũ.
grammarNote.en: The original's famous ending. 〜ても = even if ~. もとのとおり = as before.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 原作著名结尾。〜ても＝即使……。もとのとおり＝原样。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 原作著名結尾。〜ても＝即使……。もとのとおり＝原樣。
grammarNote.my: မူရင်း နာမည်ကြီး အဆုံးသတ်။
grammarNote.th: ตอนจบอันโด่งดังของต้นฉบับ
grammarNote.si: මුල් කතාවේ ප්‍රසිද්ධ අවසානය. 〜ても = ~ වුණත්. もとのとおり = කලින් විදිහටම.
